articleTitle: Efficient Pre Processing Image Filter For Multimodal Biometric System
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In the field of Multimodal Biometric System, the pre - processing plays a vital role in enhancing the authenticate and reliable biometric system. This paper introduces an efficient pre-processing image filter for multimodal biometric system. The proposed filter is designed to address the challenges of multimodal biometric system aiming to optimize the quality and consistency of images. The proposed filter is combination of Bilateral and Gaussian filter along with quantized histogram. The filter focuses on noise reduction, artifact removal, and enhanced resolution, ensuring that the further feature extraction, feature fusion and authentication process efficiently.

articleTitle: Improved Detection of Fusarium Head Blight in Wheat Ears Through SOLO Instance Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Wheat Fusarium Head Blight is a destructive fungal disease that affects wheat crops worldwide. It is caused by the fungus Fusarium graminearum, which infects the flowering heads of wheat plants during periods of high humidity and rainfall. The disease can lead to significant yield losses and reduced grain quality, making it a major concern for wheat farmers. In order to effectively manage and control Wheat Fusarium Head Blight, accurate detection and diagnosis of the disease is crucial. Traditional manual inspection techniques for detecting Wheat Fusarium Head Blight have limitations, including the need for expert knowledge, inaccuracies in diagnosis, and are labour-intensive. In light of the challenges posed by FHB, there is a pressing need to explore innovative research for FHB management. To address these limitations, researchers have developed a novel approach using deep learning and image segmentation techniques. This research paper proposes the use of SOLO (Segmenting Objects by Location), a one-shot object detection model, to enhance the precision and speed of lesion segmentation in wheat leaves affected by Wheat Fusarium Head Blight. Researchers capture detailed images of infected and healthy wheat kernels and these images can then be analysed using texture analysis techniques to extract key features that differentiate infected kernels from healthy ones. The proposed approach has achieved an impressive accuracyof 99.16%, signifying a significant scientific breakthrough. This accomplishment not only provides valuable assistance to researchers but also equips farmers with an advanced technological arsenal to combat Fusarium Head Blight.

articleTitle: Predicting the Strength of High-Performance Concrete in City
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Ensuring the stability and quality of concrete structures is crucial in the construction industry. This research paper explores the use of machine learning approaches to forecast concrete's compressive strength, an essential measure of the material's longevity and quality. Utilizing a dataset. the paper navigates through data exploration, preparation, and model application stages. We apply and assess a number of machine learning methods, such as Random Forest Repressor, Lasso, Ridge, and linear regression. The paper shows how machine learning may expedite the prediction process and provide insights into modifying concrete mixtures for increased strength and durability through exploratory data analysis and model comparisons. This research paper highlights the possibilities of data-driven initiatives and provides a thorough guidance for both data scientists and construction professionals. Methods: feature engineering, data exploration, creation of models with a variety of machine learning methods, evaluation, and comparison of models. Results: Accurate forecasts of concrete compressive strength were obtained by applying machine learning models, such as lasso, random forest, ridge, and linear regression. Predictive performance was improved using ensemble approaches and feature engineering strategies. Conclusion: machine learning provides a reliable method for estimating the compressive strength of concrete, enabling quicker and more precise quality evaluation in the field of construction engineering.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Nova Virtual Assistant to Enhance Daily Life: On Perspective of User Needs, Preferences, and Expectations
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Nova Virtual Assistant is an embedded virtual voice assistant that uses cutting-edge gTTS and Python hi-tech to create a customized assistant. By combining the capabilities of AIML with a text-to-speech platform developed by industry leader Google, Nova adds both male and feminine tones to the Marvel-powered gTTS library universe. This is frequently an outcome of using the dynamic foundation Pythons with Pyttsx that are deemed prudent in consecutive gTTS phases, which facilitate the creation of fundamentally fine-tuned conversations between users and assistant management. In addition to assisting end users with everyday tasks like word meaning, video search, image retrieval, live weather, and general human speech, it will also anticipate and prompt users for upcoming activities and assignments. The usability of AIML and its capacity to dynamically integrate with gTTS [Google Text to Speech] and Python [pyttsx] platforms often result within the identical JARVIS standard framework, exhibiting general reusability and nearly inability to maintain. This is frequently the only outcome of multiple contributors contributing excessively.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Technique to Detect Fake Accounts on Social Media
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Recognizing fraudulent activity on social media has grown in importance in the digital realm. Facebook has 11% of monthly active users who are duplicates (about 150 million as of Q32023) and 5% who are classified as “false” or “undesirable” (around 137 million) in the face of this growing difficulty. Discussions on Instagram indicated a 13% prevalence, or 270 million phony accounts. This study presents new methods and techniques for identifying and thwarting fraudulent behavior onpopular social media platforms. By using cutting-edge machine learning techniques and data analytics, the research focuses on anomaly detection, pattern recognition, and user behavior analysis to distinguish real user interactions from fraudulentones. Fraudulent activity on social networking sites poses a serious threat to users, businesses, and online communities. Using the Pandas library, this article presents a strong fraud detection system that makes use of the synergies between Random Forest, NLTK(Natural Language Toolkit), ML (Machine Learning) and recurrent neural networks approaches. Combining random forest, with ensemble learning enhances and deep learning fraud detection accuracy and effectiveness. A complete model that can identify fraudulent activity.

articleTitle: Designing and Development of AR Based Application for Studying Magnetism
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The primary objective of this paper is to create an innovative Augmented Reality (AR) solution to improve the visualization and comprehension of magnetism. The paper endeavors to implement AR technology to present a virtual environment to overlay virtual magnetic fields seamlessly onto the physical environment. By integrating digital elements with the real world. This will be accomplished by using tools such as, CoreAR SDK and Unity. Leveraging the advanced capabilities of these platforms the work tends to be a visual representation of the concepts of magnetism.

articleTitle: Visual Veracity: Advancing AI-Generated Image Detection with Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The rapid advancements of image generation models, especially prompt-based image generation models, have started a new chapter in how we understand visual information, blurring the lines between what is real and what is synthetic. Moreover, the propagation of AI-generated images across industries, coupled with the easier accessibility of generative models, raises concerns about misinformation and ethical implications. This study delves into the critical need for a robust image classification model to differentiate between real and AI-generated images. Using the CIFAKE dataset, a comprehensive collection of AI-generated and real images and employing transfer learning with various convolutional neural network (CNN) architectures, this study aims to further advance AI-generated image detection to new heights. Training of models was conducted in two phases; one involved using pre-trained weights and freezing the base model layers, while the other involved fine-tuning the base model. The most optimal model with EfficientNet as the base model achieved a validation accuracy of 97.29%. In a world where the authenticity of visual content is increasingly vital, this study holds promise for applications spanning content moderation, cybersecurity, and digital forensics.

articleTitle: Encrypting the Unseen: Exploring Steganography Techniques in HTTP Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The skill of secret communication, known as steganography, has developed in step with the growing reliance on digital channels for information sharing. This study explores the unexplored field of steganography in HTTP contexts, where information is subtly hidden beneath the surface of ostensibly benign web traffic. Through the use of sophisticated steganographic techniques, this research attempts to decipher the complex ways in which concealed messages are embedded into HTTP protocols. The study's approach includes a thorough examination of HTTP traffic and combines focus groups, interviews, and questionnaires to elicit information from a variety of sources. We examine the digital traces of steganographic practices in online conversations by using state-of-the-art tools and techniques. The main goals are to determine which steganography techniques are often used in HTTP contexts, evaluate how they affect cybersecurity, and provide mitigation solutions to improve web security measures. The results of this study should help clarify the finer points of steganographic communication, which will help create cybersecurity frameworks that are more resilient and appropriate for today's online environments. Understanding and limiting covert communication channels inside HTTP protocols becomes increasingly important as the digital landscape continues to change. “Encrypting the Unseen” acts as a lighthouse, pointing scholars, professionals, and enthusiasts in the direction of a more profound understanding of the function that steganography plays in protecting, or endangering, the hidden spheres of online communication.

articleTitle: Implementation of Blockchain Solutions with MiniFabric for Rapid Prototyping
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: There is a significant demand for solutions based on blockchain technology because blockchain solutions tackle difficulties with efficiency, security, trust, and transparency in a variety of industries, which makes it a useful tool for resolving a wide range of concerns. Although blockchain technology has shown great promise in several use cases, adoption of blockchain-based solutions is hindered by a number of issues, including its complexity, lack of understanding, regulatory uncertainty, and energy consumption. Blockchain and cryptocurrency regulations are still being developed by numerous governments and regulatory agencies. It can be difficult to implement blockchain solutions and may call for specific expertise in decentralized network administration, smart contracts, and cryptography. It is essential to enhance education and awareness about blockchain technology to address these concerns. The technology's slower adoption might be attributed to the limited awareness among potential users regarding its capabilities and potential applications. Hence, it is clear that gaining proficiency in blockchain technology necessitates specific training and awareness. This research work aims to illustrate the utilization of MiniFabric tools in the development of solutions based on blockchain as this tool is good for rapid prototyping. To illustrate the implementation of the blockchain solution using the Mini Fabric tool, a scenario has been devised involving the presence of multiple organizations and peers within the network and then read and write operations are performed to compute the success rate. This study observed 100% success rate during both read and write operations at varying TPS (Transactions Per Second).

articleTitle: Leveraging AI-Generated Image for Scene Classification: A transfer Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: When it comes to scene classification, the lack of labelled data is a significant obstacle that forces researchers to think about innovative solutions. This work presents a revolutionary method to strengthen scene classification models by combining transfer learning with AI-generated images. A key component of this project is the construction of a carefully curated dataset of 3672 augmented AI-generated photos in a total of 6 scenes. This database not only serves as a helpful resource for additional research but also makes a substantial contribution to this area of research. Using this dataset, a VGG16 model is trained, demonstrating the usefulness of synthetic data with a notable increase in accuracy. The model's performance is further improved through subsequent training using realistic photos through transfer learning, thereby surpassing the initial baseline. This work demonstrates the transformative effect of transfer learning on scene categorization accuracy and verifies its effectiveness using synthetic data through rigorous testing and evaluation. The results open the door for AI-generated photos to be used as an effective approach to address data scarcity issues in scene classification, which will help real-world applications improve.

articleTitle: Intelligent System for Improving Scalability by Sharding for Agriculture Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Experts attribute the success of Bitcoin to its underlying public and permissionless blockchain technology. Permissionless blockchains offer solutions to various worldly challenges, from eCommerce to governance and arbitration. However, the agriculture supply chain is a crucial sector that deserves attention. Many blockchain-based agriculture traceability systems have been developed by recent researchers using blockchain and smart contracts. While existing systems achieve security and decentralization on a large scale, they suffer from severe performance and scalability limitations. This work introduces a blockchain traceability system for the Agriculture Supply Chain (ASC) using a Proof of Stake (PoS) sharding approach to enhance scalability and operational efficiency. The proposed system comprises a coord layer, sharding layer, cross shard, and communication layer implemented using Python and the MPICH message passing library. The system distributes the computational workload among a specified number of nodes across the network, leveraging the sharding mechanism to achieve higher transaction throughput limits. The simulation results reveal that with a consistent throughput, an increase in transactions leads to longer processing times when the shard count remains the same. However, when the shard count increases, there is a significant improvement in throughput, albeit with a higher number of nodes and longer processing times. Therefore, the proposed system demonstrates enhanced throughput in sharded systems compared to existing systems.

articleTitle: Smart Forecasting: Harnessing Machine Learning for Accurate CO2 Emission Predictions
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: This The tenacity of this study is to improve a Machine Learning (ML) model to enhance the precision of Carbon Dioxide (CO2) emission predictions. This study utilizes the cutting-edge forecasting techniques for a more accurate understanding of environmental impact. This study will harness the power of smart forecasting to inform strategic decision-making in carbon mitigation efforts. In this research, the performance metrics of four commonly used ML classifiers, namely LR, Gaussian Process, MLP and SMOreg have been evaluated to foretell CO2 emissions using the dataset collected from Kaggle. The dataset was pre-processed, and all the algorithms were trained and tested. The number of instances used in this study is 935. The results of this investigation show that machine learning algorithms are capable of producing accurate CO2 emission forecasts. The findings suggest that the SMOreg Classifier is more accurate than the LR (LR), Gaussian Process Regression (GPR) and Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) classifiers for predicting CO2 emissions. This study emphasizes the possibility of using ML algorithms to predict CO2 emissions. The error values such as MSE, RMSE, MAE, Correlation Coefficient and Root relative squared error indicates the performance of SMOreg is a superior classifier for the forecasting, these results have an important implication in climate change for improving prediction models, which could assist in early detection of climate change.

articleTitle: Using Swin Transformer and SIFT Algorithm to Detect Bone Abnormalities
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: This research paper investigates the combination of cutting-edge deep learning architectures, specifically the Swin Transformer, with conventional feature extraction methods, such as the Scale-Invariant Feature Transform (SIFT) algorithm, for the identification and classification of fractures. We seek to improve the accuracy and robustness of fracture identification from medical pictures by integrating characteristics acquired from SIFT with the capabilities of Swin Transformer during a 16- week period, we show the efficacy of our hybrid technique through thorough experimentation and evaluation, providing insights into its performance in comparison to traditional methods. Our research advances fracture diagnosis techniques, which may lead to more precise and effective clinical decision-making in hospital settings.

articleTitle: NIRNAY: An AI Chess Engine Based on Convolutional Neural Network, Negamax and Move Ordering
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Chess, one of the world's most popular games, has come a long way from the time it has gone digital. Now almost every year, efforts are being made to improve existing engines or towards building powerful engines on some new algorithms. All these efforts are making the game difficult yet interesting for chess lovers. These chess engines, created using different algorithms like pruning, Monte Carlo Search Tree, are so powerful that they are known to defeat some of the world-famous chess grandmasters using their high computational power, by predicting the most optimized legal chess move. But still, there is a large-scale hidden opportunity to explore the applications of machine learning to create stronger and more efficient engines. In this paper, we have proposed an innovative contribution, depicting the application of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Negamax approach in building a robust engine.

articleTitle: A Compact Circular Patch Antenna for Microwave and Millimeter-Wave Communication (Ku-k-Ka)
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: An offset fed circular patch with partial-ground is etched to radiate electromagnetic energy in the microwave and millimeter-wave band. The patch is placed on a substrate made of RT/Duroid, which has a thickness(t) of 0.787mm and measures 9.5×6.5mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The substrate has a dielectric constant (also known as sub r) of 2.2 and a loss tangent (tan delta) of 0.0009. A partial ground and offset feed are used for better impedance bandwidth and improved impedance matching. This antenna design offers an impedance bandwidth of 13.2GHz, which covers partial Ku band from 16.5-18 GHz, full K-band spectrum from 18–27 GHz, and some portion of Ka-band from 27-29.7GHz. It includes 28GHz as well as 29 GHz frequencies from millimeter bands with resonance at 26.8GHz.

articleTitle: Compressed Domain Image Watermarking for Color Images
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In today's digital landscape, the surging volume of multimedia data calls for innovative solutions to tackle challenges related to storage efficiency and secure content ownership. This paper introduces a cutting-edge framework addressing image compression and secure ownership verification for color images. Employing K-means clustering, our proposed methodology achieves an impressive compression ratio of 3.99, ensuring efficient data storage. To verify ownership securely, our approach utilizes a watermarking scheme embedding a logo in the LH1 sub-band, obtained through successive lifting wavelet transformations applied to the Y channel's LH band in the YCbCr color space. This methodology exhibits exceptional robustness, as evidenced by NCC values either equal to or in close proximity to unity. Comparative analyses against recent techniques validate its superior performance in both compression and authentication. This integrated solution holds great promise for applications requiring simultaneous image compression and content ownership, marking a significant contribution to advancements in image processing techniques.

articleTitle: Analysis of External Power Source in Agricultural Fields Energy Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Renewable energy plants integrated are obtained locally, including hydro, biogas, as well as solar. The construction of hydropower and biogas with while solar power plants were constructed. The primary issue is that all current RE's energy sources Power plants are intermittent, meaning they are not always available. Solar power is only used in the daytime. Ultimately, significant concept is put into practice to preserve the supply-demand energy balance, lower grid electricity costs with the penetration of renewable energy sources, and enhance the local grid's efficiency, security, and dependability. The concept is put into practice to preserve the supply-demand energy balance, lower grid electricity costs with the penetration of renewable energy sources, and enhance the local grid's efficiency, security, and dependability. The availability of wind energy is subject to seasonal and meteorological fluctuations, making it unpredictable at times. The same is true of hydro energy sources, which are significantly less in the summer and quite abundant during the rainy season. The quantity of animals and the availability of feed have a significant impact on the source of biogas energy.

articleTitle: Real-Time Speech to Sign Language Translation Using Machine and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: This approach critically analyzed the current technology for speech-to-sign language translation. To extract key features from the input speech signal, audio processing techniques such as Mel-frequency cepstral coefficients (MFCCs), Fast Fourier transform (FFT), and Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) are used first. Combining the advantages of both architectures—convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and recurrent neural networks (RNNs)—creates a potent feature extraction method that can effectively extract features with both temporal and spatial patterns. Following their retrieval, the attributes are input into a Text-to-Sign (TTS) module, which uses a Convolutional Long Short-Term Memory (ConvLSTM) network to generate the proper sign language sequence. The created sequence of sign language is animated using motion graphics (MG). This technology uses motion capture data that has already been recorded to create realistic and expressive sign language motions. Motion graphics offer an appropriate choice for real-time translation applications that will be using Long Short-Term Memory Long time (LSTM) by balancing usability with the size of the necessary motion capture database.

articleTitle: Blockchain Technology in Fintech Sector
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: This research introduces a new way of doing things by combining a Decentralized Autonomous Cryptocurrency Portfolio Management system with a Blockchain-Powered Cryptocurrency Market Analytics Platform. The main goal is to change how we handle cryptocurrency portfolios, giving users up-to-the-minute insights into the market. Moreover, the study aims to establish a strong and secure financial environment in the world of cryptocurrencies. This unique blend aims to usher in a whole new approach, catering to the changing requirements of users in the ever-shifting cryptocurrency scenario. Moreover, this integrated system goes beyond just improving how portfolios are managed. It also helps users make decisions based on real-time market analysis and predictive insights. By using blockchain technology, it offers users greater transparency and trust in their investment choices. Plus, because it's decentralized, it's more resistant to security risks. With cryptocurrencies becoming more popular in mainstream finance, this research offers a solution that meets the changing needs of investors and enthusiasts. Ultimately, it aims to create a cryptocurrency ecosystem that's more efficient and inclusive.

articleTitle: Exploring Dynamic Scenes: 3D CNN-Based Activity Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The necessity of precisely extracting 3D models from freehand sketches is discussed in this study, especially in light of the expanding number of these models that are available online. It presents a research strategy that integrates convolutional neural networks (CNNs) with interactive attention to enhance the accuracy of 3D model retrieval by taking form distribution characteristics and semantic aspects into account. It also presents a novel method for 3D CNN-based activity retrieval in films, highlighting the importance of 3D CNNs in activity retrieval for video analysis and human activity recognition. Through empirical data, the research highlights the efficacy of the 3D CNN-based activity recognition model and investigates the architecture's capacity to capture dynamic movements and interactions inside video sequences. All things considered, this work offers fresh perspectives and approaches to the problems of 3D CNN-based activity recognition in video data.

articleTitle: Usage of Artificial Intelligence in Establishing the Linkage Between Intellect and Anthropomorphism in IT Sector
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Applications of artificial intelligence (AI) are seen in a variety of industries, including services, where the field's remarkable rate of change is fueled by technological advancements. AI has improved efficiency and raised interaction levels by being used in people's daily job and in forming the relationship between businesses and their clients. Customers do, however, have concerns about the application of AI. Thus, it is worthwhile to look into how AI impacts customer Reliance. The primary focus of this study is the applications of AI and how they affect consumer Reliance. This study looks on the anthropomorphism and interaction of AI applications. Applications of AI are drastically changing how customers and service providers communicate. We investigate the relationship between consumers' faith in AI applications and their humanness. Focus group data yielded qualitative information that sheds new light on the functions of intelligence and anthropomorphism as essential notions of what it is to be human. Our research reveals how customers view the subtleties of these constructs as they relate to services made possible by AI technologies.

articleTitle: Enhancing File Recovery from Distributed File Systems (DFSs) Using Erasure Coding and Replication
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Several solutions have been used in distributed file systems to increase data availability and dependability. Historically, replication techniques were the favored method for storing data in such systems. However, there has been a recent movement towards the use of erasure-coding (EC) methods to overcome space efficiency concerns. While EC is more successful than replication approaches in overcoming space efficiency difficulties, it introduces its own performance degradation factors, such as encoding and decoding delays, as well as input and output (I/O). To address these issues, this research proposes a buffering and combining strategy. This solution combines several I/O requests made throughout the encoding process in an EC-based distributed file system into a single operation, resulting in more efficient processing. In addition, the research recommends four recovery strategies to reduce the impact of decoding on disk input/output loads. These measures include disk input/output load distribution, random block layout, multi-thread parallel recovery, and the matrix recycling approach. All of these methods are intended to optimize the distribution of disk input/output loads produced during the decoding process.

articleTitle: SRNF-PAR: Strawberry and Recurrent Neural Framework-based Physiotherapy Activity Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Person activity recognition is now a research area in computer vision. The various applications of this area include healthcare, sports and suspicious activity detection. This study focused on physiotherapy exercise activity. The video dataset of physiotherapy is limited; therefore, it was collected from YouTube for shoulder therapy. The exercise has many activities thing is available to understand it all, here more than one activity in sequence wants to do with some activity repetition. Therefore, the deep learning-based algorithm such as in recurrent neural networks the long short-term memory technique will help to determine the exercise with the help of sub-activity order and the other parameter will identify which activity is repeated and the duration of exercise activity with the pose of the person to perform the activity such as static, dynamic and transition. All parameters were obtained using the novel approach of a strawberry-based recurrent neural network for physiotherapy activity recognition (SBRNN-PAR). This algorithm will classify the sub-activity, recognize the exercise with repeated counts and identify the human pose to perform the activity. The idea for a model shows a higher performance in evaluation.

articleTitle: Predictive Algorithms for Early Postpartum Depression Detection: CatBoost vs. LightGBM
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Postpartum depression (PPD) is a growing concern for mothers on a global stage and is usually linked to the varied emotional changes which happen to a woman postdelivery. This issue is a pressing one and as such early detection acts as the essential bridge between growth and development of the mother-child bond while promoting a nurturing environment. The paper makes use of two classification algorithms namely, CatBoost and LightGBM, on a dataset of 1503 records, with the primary aim to list out the various indicators which contribute to PPD. It has been seen that varied emotional indicators such as guilt, anger, sleep depravity and irritability act as the prime indicators of this disease. While comparing the two algorithms CatBoost outshines LightGBM owing to its prowess in handling categorical data and its ordered boosting approaches. In all this study outlines the potential of these algorithms in predictive modelling as well as timely detection of this disease, establishing the foundation for better efforts to mitigate and manage PPD.

articleTitle: Chess Opening Analysis Using DBSCAN Clustering and Predictive Modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: This document serves as a live template for scholarly research on the topic “Chess Openings Characterization through DBSCAN Clustering and Predictive Modeling.” In this study we implemented the Density Based Spatial Clustering of Application with Noise (DBSCAN) algorithm on standardized player ratings and one-hot encoded opening moves used by different players. The clusters are labeled based on strategic similarities. Afterwards a prediction model is built using cluster labels along with other features examining how their results can influence the game outcome and thus understanding how opening patterns affect the overall game. The findings from this study makean important contribution to strategic decision-making and the field of chess, demonstrating the potential of DBSCAN in game analytics.

articleTitle: From Frisee to Belgian Endive: A Deep Learning and Ensemble Approach to Classifying Endive Varieties in India
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The proposed study looks at the types of Frisée, Escarole, and Belgian Endive in India using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) with team learning. A set with 9,000 big pictures was carefully gathered. It showed many different features of these endive types. The study works on making models better and faster in telling the difference between complex endive types. This is important for farming practices and selling them at markets. The made model got a very good total correctness of 98.17% in sorting the different types of endive. The table with details shows that this model can accurately sort every kind of endive. It uses metrics like precision, recall, and F1-score to measure its performance. Figure 3 shows a table called the confusion matrix. It helps people understand why certain predictions are wrong and gives tips on how to make them better for more precise results. This study is a big step forward to make sorting endive types automatic in India, reducing the need to depend on human opinions. The model's high precision promises better farming methods, making sure food quality is safe and simplifying selling in markets. Furthermore, it can do more than just categorize endives. It also has the potential to help sort out plants and make farming machines work better. This study shows how CNN and Ensemble Learning can change farming by using smart computer methods. Using these techniques correctly shows what can be done in the future. They aim to improve accuracy, speed, and long-lasting methods of farming not only in India but also around the world.

articleTitle: Bibliometric Mapping of Theme and Trends of Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: By examining three research topics, this review paper examines the state of blockchain technology research. To grasp the most recent improvements and innovations, it is first necessary to analyse the state of the advancement in the field of blockchain. Second, the nations and organisations that have significantly contributed to the study of blockchain technology are named. Finally, the field's most well-liked study areas and keyword trends are examined. The study's conclusions provide a comprehensive assessment of the state of blockchain technol-ogy research at present, highlighting significant developments, significant nations and institutions, and new fields of study. This analysis will help scholars, decision-makers, and business experts comprehend the current state of knowledge and suggest promising areas for research and collaboration in the area of blockchain.

articleTitle: Design, Simulation and Comparative Analysis of Wideband & Multiband Fractal Antenna for 5G and Wireless Application
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In this paper, a multiband and wideband of fractal antenna has been proposed for wireless communication applications. The Sierpinski carpet geometry has been applied to design the antenna up to third iteration. The multi frequency characteristics of the Sierpinski Carpet are characterized by its successive iterations. The proposed antenna is designed at 1.8GHz on FR-4 epoxy substrate having dielectric constant 4.4 and dimensions 60x50x1.6 mm3. The performance of the antenna has been analyzed in terms of return loss, gain, VSWR, bandwidth and efficiency with the operating frequency ranges between 1 to 10GHz. The simulation results obtain from the third iteration resonates with different frequency range of 3.4GHz, 4.8GHz, 7.7GHz, 8.6GHz, 9.4GHz and 9.7GHz with bandwidth of 98MHz, 148MHz, 344MHz, 152MHz, 678MHz and 678MHz respectively. These antennas have good antenna gains such as - 0.17dB, 4.89dB, 0.68dB, 5.66dB, 4.9dB, 4.9dB at corresponding frequencies. These resonance frequencies are able to operate for WLAN, RMM, Wi-Fi, UWB, LLWS, Wi-MAX, NAVAID, Satellite and Radar applications.

articleTitle: Virtual Digital Electronics Engineering Laboratory for Online learning after COVID19
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Nowadays learning aspects are changed after Covid19. Parents are attracted towards new trends of Online education. An attempt is made here for crating virtual laboratory in engineering education. This paper is intended to create awareness among under graduate and post graduate students of technical courses about virtual laboratories The most basic subject which has to be learn by computer science, Information Technology, electrical and electronics engineering students is Digital Electronics. Virtual experiments are created here which do not require any kind of real hardware. An online tool Tinkercad is used here to simulate the basic experiments of Digital Electronics Circuits. Some of the basic experiments like logic gates, Boolean functions implementation, combinational circuits and sequential circuits are simulated here. This virtual laboratory allows students to understand and grasp the experiments by their own at flexible time and at own speed. Even Faculties can develop the basic projects and allow students to perform it.

articleTitle: The Impact of Machine Learning Based Framework on Network Traffic Performance in Mobile Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: System learning has become a well-liked instrument for promoting efficient and environmentally friendly decision-making in a growing number of settings. Mobile Ad Hoc Networks (MANETs) are particularly challenging settings because of their dynamic topologies, erratic communication, and frequently unpredictable traffic patterns. This research presents the usefulness of a machine learning-based general framework for improving the performance of community visitors in MANETs. This technique uses support vector machines (SVM) for different visitor kinds, assesses the type's correctness for unique scenarios, and makes use of community optimization tools for improved overall performance. An extensive performance assessment using a range of network scenarios and visitor types shows how well the suggested architecture handles community website visitors' performance. The results show that the suggested framework can correctly identify the styles of the visitors and modify the community parameters to enhance performance. Furthermore, the suggested method can be applied without issue in real-world circumstances and can improve the overall performance of the conventional system.

articleTitle: Blind and Robust Watermarking Framework for Audio Signals
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In today's era of pervasive audio piracy, protecting audio signals' copyrights has become crucial due to widespread intellectual property violations. Prior robust digital audio watermarking techniques have emphasized robustness but often lacked imperceptibility and embedding capacity. Addressing this gap, this research introduced a highly resilient and blind audio watermarking framework based on a thresholding approach. The suggested technique generates transform parameters by applying LWT to the host signal. The bits of watermark are placed in the LH sub-band of the audio data. Experimental results highlighted the scheme's resilience against various attack types. Embedding the watermark into the LH sub-band, the given framework maintains imperceptibility with Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) between 38 to 42 dB and NCC values of 1 under no attack. Comparative analysis showcases its resilience against multiple attacks, as demonstrated by the NCC values either equal or close to 1. Furthermore, this framework demonstrates an impressive payload capacity of 178.08 bps, underscoring its substantial capability in embedding data.

articleTitle: Simplified Plant Health Monitoring using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: This paper examines how superintending is pivotal for plant health in the modern world. One serious cause of low collect yield is an infection brought about by microorganisms, infection, and organisms. Plant disease investigation is one of the major and essential tasks in the part of cultivating. Plant diseases stratification enhance feasible based on Convolutional neural network(CNN) architecture, Xception Model,DenseNet.Image Clarification of plant in early stages and analysing environmental sensing not only helps farmers to get healthy plants and Knowing the various diseases can help farmers in numerous way, and also maximize the production. Thus, classifying pre-examining diseases helps farmers to grow healthy fabrication of the environment. The authors of this paper applied a variety of deep learning classification algorithms, such as CNN, Xception, and DenseNet121, to a variety of image datasets that are accessible at https://github.com/T-EJ/plant-health-detection.git. The results of the study shows that accuracy of CNN algorithm to detect disease in plant leaves is 89% which is highest as compared with Xception, and DenseNet121.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Blueberry Mosaic Disease Severity Classification with CNN-AdaBoost Hybrid Model
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The proposed study introduces a new way of measuring how bad Blueberry Mosaic Disease (BMD) is using an advanced learning method that combines Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) with AdaBoost. A carefully selected collection of 12,000 blueberry leaf pictures showing different levels of BMD damage is used as the base. Experts in the field carefully prepared and labeled data to help teach from examples. The mix of Deep Learning shows very good results, getting an all-around rightness of 98.20/0 in sorting out how risky BMD is. In Table I, performance measures such as precision rate, recall percentage, and F1 score tell how good the model is at telling different levels of seriousness apart. The Confusion Matrix helps to see what the model does well and where it needs improvement. This model's success in being right about the levels of BMD shows it might be a very important tool for treating diseases exactly in blueberry farms. It gives farmers and crop experts a quick, machine-driven way to find problems early. This lets them come up with special plans for dealing with these issues. The study's effects are not just about BMD. It shows how fancy technology can change the way of looking at diseases in farming too. This study builds a strong base for future improvements, aiming to improve the model's accuracy, size, and real-world use in making sure blueberry crops grow healthy.

articleTitle: Increasing Trust and Privacy by Using Blockchain Technology in the Onion Router Network
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel hybrid method to increase trust and privacy in the Onion Router (Tor) network by integrating blockchain technology and Zero Knowledge Proofs (ZKPs). Leveraging principles from trust-based anonymous communication, the proposed method aims to establish a decentralized trust layer within the Tor network, enhancing integrity and reliability. By incorporating ZKPs’ power of privacy and authentication, blockchain's immutability and Tor's anonymity, the method seeks to address trust and privacy concerns within the Tor network. This hybrid approach offers a comprehensive solution to increase trust and privacy in the Tor network, aligning with their growing importance in the digital age.

articleTitle: Predictive Health Assistant: AI-Driven Disease Projection Tool
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: This study emphasizes the potential of chatbots in revolutionizing healthcare, particularly in the context of infectious disease management. While hospitals have long been the primary source of medical check-ups, diagnoses, and treatment recommendations worldwide, the rise of chatbots, powered by artificial intelligence, is changing the landscape of healthcare delivery. Chatbots enable users to seek medical information and assistance in a manner like conversing with a human. They are gaining rapid adoption, especially in computer chat platforms. The paper highlights the challenges faced by individuals with busy schedules, who often spend considerable time waiting for doctor appointments, particularly for diseases that require prolonged treatment, such as heart disease. Heart disease remains a prevalent global health issue, causing numerous fatalities every day. The future of healthcare depends on remote data collection, accurate distance diagnoses, and AI-driven data analysis, all of which can significantly enhance both healthcare efficiency and outcomes. The proposed chatbot system aims to empower users by facilitating daily health check-ups, raising health awareness, and encouraging proactive health measures. Despite its potential, this research reveals that such systems are underutilized, and public awareness remains limited. Implementing the proposed framework can reduce the time-consuming process of visiting hospitals, offering a convenient and accessible healthcare solution.

articleTitle: NextGen Learning: Hybrid Mode Prediction with Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: This paper presents the machine learning model to predict whether hybrid learning will be a sustainable solution. A binary classification problem to identify the hybrid learning mode has been solved. The primary samples are trained and tested with the help of the Random Forest (RAF) algorithm with 86% accuracy. The learning curve of the yellowbrick library proved an insignificant difference between the test and training accuracy and a sufficient number of samples trained for the RAF model. The calibration curve found the highest probability of 90% occurrence of positives. The RAF model gained high precision, recall, and a f1-score of 0.86. At threshold 50, precision is 0.66, f-score is 0.77, accuracy is 0.69, and recall is 0.96. The RAF model's output is also validated and explained using SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations), and novel significant features are recommended.

Index Terms: Performance Of The Random Forest Model

articleTitle: Enhanced Personality Profiling: Unveiling MBTI Traits Through Machine Learning Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: This machine learning paper analyzes the MBTI personality dataset, comprising 16 personality types. It employs a structured approach, including Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA), data grouping, visualization, preprocessing, feature engineering, and model training with both 60–40 and improved 70–30 splits. The study compares the performance of various algorithms and concludes with a robust verification process. The insights gained contribute to understanding the interplay between personality traits and associated features, with potential applications in personality assessment and human resources.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of RF Based War Spying Robot with Wireless Night Vision Camera
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The paper explains RF (Radio Frequency) based spying robot for wireless devices, it will help to investigate as per requirement. The proposed spying robot methodology it can be controlled by an application that is running on the android mobile can control the spying robot. In the proposed method uses esp 32 cam 3b, different types of the sensor for the investigation purpose. It does so by transmitting control commands over bluetooth, which are then received by the processor. The UART (Universal Asynchronous Receiver Transmitter) protocol can be used to establish a connection between the processor and the bluetooth module. articleTitle: Prototype Specification for a Speed Breaker to Generate Electricity
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Electricity is one of the most important inventions. It has now become an important component of modern living, and it is impossible to grasp occurrence without that. In our everyday lives, power generation performs a variety of functions. Is used to light areas, operate fans, and charge domestic appliances such as induction cook tops and air conditioning units. Today one cannot imagine a life without electricity. It is also very important in industrial uses. Today we produce electricity mainly with non-renewable resources. The non-renewable resources are exploited heavily and cause a lot of pollution. Scientists have been exploring new solutions for electricity production for decades. The proposed idea is one such effort looking into an alternative method. The idea is to implement an IoT based speed breaker which generates electricity. The speed breaker generates electricity when vehicles pass over it.

articleTitle: Acne Detection Care System using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Millions of people worldwide suffer from acne, a common dermatological ailment that frequently causes both physical and psychological discomfort. The prevalence of acne, a common skin condition, poses a significant challenge to derma-tologists and individuals seeking effective skincare solutions. This research introduces ‘Acne Care’, an innovative system that leverages deep learning techniques and Reset18 application for the detection and personalized care of acne. This model analyse various skin abnormalities and make a severity detection system based on the classification using deep learning algorithms. This ensemble model could accurately predict the number, location, and severity of acne at the same time. It might also be a useful tool for the patient to self-test and help the doctor diagnose them. This paper presents the development, methodology, and potential impact of this model, addressing the growing need for more efficient and effective acne management. The findings of this research paper contribute to the development and advancement of deep learning based regression models to assess the severity level of acne lesions from selfie images and their management.

articleTitle: Comparative Evaluation of Human Action Recognition using Deep Learning Architectures
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Recent developments in deep learning have revolutionized the field of activity recognition by humans and other entities. These advancements allow models to learn complex representations and hierarchies from raw data, hence increasing recognition accuracy. Many machine learning methods, such as histogram of gradients with k-nearest neighbor classifiers and support vector machines, have lost part of their appeal due to the extensive feature engineering and data preparation required. The aim of this work is to construct a detailed study utilizing CNN (convolutional neural networks), Inception network model, and Resnet model showcasing the promising results while removing the need for sophisticated feature manipulation. Furthermore, the study makes use of a large and diverse dataset that includes over 12,000 annotated photos illustrating various human activities. - This study advances deep learning techniques focused on human - activity recognition, showing possible improvements in efficacy and precision in real-world scenarios.

articleTitle: Yoga Posture Analysis using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: We live in a society where happiness is crucial for living and this happiness can be attained by having a fit body. For this fit body, yoga is a key element. Yoga posture analysis using deep learning is a significant step for fusing ancient wisdom with the newfound cutting edge and innovative technology. Specialized deep learning methods have been used such as CNN (Convolutional neural network). It is the main neural network for analyzing the yoga poses. This ability is due to the structure of CNN, the intricate patterns it can recognize in the data. These models are also a way forward in the case of image recognition. Key alignments are carefully identified and analyzed with respect to the posture. Initial results have shown YOLO to have an average precision of 92.5% on the kaggle dataset, as compared to 91.80% precision for MediaPipe and 85.94% for OpenPose. All the models discussed in this paper are well capable of recognizing poses and layers of network are working here for determining the posture.

articleTitle: Advancing Industrial Effluent Monitoring Systems for Environmental Protection and Sustainable Development
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Industrial Effluent Monitoring Systems (IEMS) serve as vital tools for upholding environmental regulations and safeguarding public health and ecosystems. These systems are designed to assess the quality of wastewater discharged from industrial facilities, enabling monitoring of various parameters including pH, temperature, conductivity, Total Dissolved Solids (TDS), Biochemical Oxygen Demand (BOD), Chemical Oxygen Demand (COD), nutrients, heavy metals, and toxic organic compounds. The choice of parameters to monitor depends on the specific industry and the regulations that pertain to it. In recent years, there has been a notable shift towards automated IEMS, driven by their increased efficiency and accuracy. Automated systems offer the significant advantage of real-time data collection, which facilitates the early identification and prompt resolution of environmental issues, reducing the risk of non-compliance and pollution incidents. This paper presents a comprehensive overview of the latest advancements in IEMS technology and underscores their role in enhancing environmental protection. It also references related research, contributing to a broader understanding of the field. By embracing these innovative monitoring systems and staying abreast of technological developments, industries can not only ensure compliance but also minimize their ecological footprint, fostering a more sustainable and responsible approach to wastewater management.

articleTitle: Blockchain based Energy Management and Trading System
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: When renewable energy sources (RESs) are used to generate energy at user premises, the application of local energy creation and peer-to-peer (P2P) energy exchange in the local market can help reduce energy consumption costs and emissions of harmful gases while also enhancing the resilience of the smart grid. In order to establish a blockchain-based hybrid P2P energy trading market, this article suggests a method. Because a blockchain system is by its very nature decentralized, market players can easily communicate and exchange energy without the involvement of a middleman. Because they contain the necessary regulations for energy trading, smart contracts are very important in the blockchainbased energy trading market. In order to operationalize the hybrid electricity trading market, we have suggested three smart contracts. Participants in the market communicate with the main smart contract, which communicates with the prosumer-to-grid (P2G) and P2P smart contracts for additional processing. The main goals of this study are to create a model that will help construct an effective hybrid energy trading market with the least amount of expenses and peak-to-average ratio (PAR) of power.

articleTitle: Multi - Camera Person of Interest Tracking in Crowded Scenes Using Homography and Re-Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In crowded and multi-camera surveillance scenarios, ensuring accurate tracking of individuals across different camera views is a complex challenge. A multi-faceted approach is thus used to address this issue. The YOLOv8 (You Only Look Once) object detection model is used for real-time detection in each camera stream. A Homography Matrix is employed for geometric alignment and calibration of cameras, ensuring a consistent and unified perspective. This technique proves crucial in scenarios where cameras are placed at varying angles and heights. DeepSORT, a state-of-the-art tracking algorithm, utilizes a deep neural network for person re-identification. This algorithm excels in distinguishing individuals, even in densely populated environments. By leveraging the Homography Matrix for geometric alignment and DeepSORT for precise person tracking, the proposed system achieves reliable multi-camera person tracking in challenging and crowded surveillance settings.

articleTitle: Ethical Considerations in Data Mining and Database Research
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In the dynamic realm of data mining and database research, ethical considerations are crucial for ensuring responsible practices. [1] This paper delves into the ethical dimensions inherent in data mining within database research, addressing challenges and proposing solutions. It focuses on issues like data privacy, informed consent, algorithmic bias, and transparency. The research has a dual purpose: firstly, to comprehensively assess ethical aspects, unraveling dilemmas faced by researchers; and secondly, to formulate guidelines fostering ethical conduct in data mining. In this paper different variables have been identified and component analysis has been applied to identify the important variable as per the responses of the professional in the field of data mining. From the result it is very clear that the two most dominant factors which hold prominent place in the field of ethical consideration in data mining are Regulatory environment and trust and acceptance. The ethical consideration should stem from the said variables as tested through a questionnaire. By enhancing ethical awareness and accountability, the research contributes to maintaining the integrity of data-driven research practices, providing valuable insights into the complexities of the field and promoting transparency and societal trust.

articleTitle: Dynamic Sign Language Recognition with Hybrid CNN-LSTM and 1D Convolutional Layers
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Our study presents a novel approach for sign language recognition (SLR) using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), 1D convolutional layers, and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks. By integrating CNN and 1D convolutional layers to capture temporal patterns and LSTM layers for handling long-term dependencies, our model achieves accurate classification of sign language gestures. We also discuss future directions, including expanding the model's recognition capabilities to other sign languages and enabling user customization, to enhance inclusivity and user-friendliness within the sign language community. This work contributes to advancing SLR technology and improving communication accessibility for individuals with hearing impairments.

articleTitle: Behavior in Derivative Trading and Global Perspectives on Retail Investor Sentiment
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The paper has shed light on the sentiment and behaviour of retail investors all over the globe towards the “derivative trading market”. It has been identified in the research, that the inclusivity of the derivative market created equal opportunities for retail investors along with institutional investors who previously dominated this market alone. The study includes a secondary data collection method by considering both the qualitative and quantitative data on the research topic. It has been found that herd behaviour and impulsive sentimental decisions are often observed among retail investors while trading due to a lack of knowledge and access to financial institutions.

articleTitle: A Biometric Security Model for The Enhancement of Data Security
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In this modern world of technology, data protection has become a top concern for both individuals and businesses. The ever-present threat of identity theft highlights the limitations of traditional security measures such as encrypted passwords and authenticated IDs. This study addresses the growing challenges of cybersecurity by proposing a new biometric security model that specifically focuses on fingerprint recognition. Fingerprints are unique to each person and have historically served as a reliable method of personal identification. Our research leverages the proven accuracy and efficiency of fingerprint recognition and advocates its integration into traditional password-based authentication processes. The synergy of fingerprint recognition and passwords ensures that only authenticated users have access to sensitive information, protecting it from theft and misuse. The urgent need for robust information security is driving the increased adoption of biometric data. This paper addresses his twin goals of user authentication and privacy and provides an in-depth look at biometrics as a good alternative to traditional methods. Biometric authentication based on various physical and behavioural characteristics of people provides excellent protection against theft, loss, or unauthorized access. provides a comprehensive overview and provides insight into its effectiveness and limitations. This paper contributes to ongoing efforts to address vulnerabilities in current authentication systems by identifying gaps and suggesting directions for future research. The proposed biometric security model represents an important step towards enhancing data security and countering evolving cyber threats in the digital era.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis and Comparison of Machine Learning Models in Early Diabetes Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: There are many chronic diseases nowadays affecting several lives and one such disease is Diabetes Mellitus, commonly known as Diabetes. Also, keeping in mind the importance of health and quality of life, it is important to learn about diseases. Diabetes is no longer counted as a disease but a main lifestyle issue that has come into progression due to the modern lifestyle change of people. This disease, if ignored for a longer time, can be a threat to the person's life. Hence, advanced detection of this disease becomes particularly important, which is possible now with scientific research. Machine Learning has positively impacted the health sector by giving different technologies for predicting different diseases and has provided the medical industry with many innovations. This study shows the result for the same as in this, a comparative study between Decision Tree, Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest (RF) and Logistic Regression (LR) has been made to predict diabetes. As a result, we would be checking which algorithm is more accurate to predict diabetes. According to this study, the model that gives the highest accuracy of 99% is random forest classifier.

articleTitle: Enhancing Lung Cancer Diagnosis Through Convolutional Neural Networks: A Comprehensive Study on Image-Based Detection and Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: This study investigates how well image-based detection and classification of lung cancer may be achieved with Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). The goal of the project is to apply deep learning techniques to improve the efficiency and accuracy of lung cancer diagnosis while addressing the shortcomings of current diagnostic methods. With the help of a well selected dataset of lung pictures, used a methodical approach that included data collecting, preprocessing, and the creation of a CNN model specifically designed for this purpose. The experimental results show that the suggested model performs better than previous methods, with a noticeable increase in accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity. Our results highlight CNNs' potential to transform the diagnosis of lung cancer by offering a thorough grasp of their capabilities for image-based detection and classification. The findings of this study have ramifications for the larger field of medical imaging and open the door to quicker and more precise lung cancer diagnosis, which will lead to better patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Detection and Classification of Plant Disease Using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Grapevine, a vital crop in India, faces substantial threats from diseases influenced by both poor soil quality and unfavorable weather conditions. The economic impact on farmers due to crop damage is significant. To mitigate these losses, an early detection system is crucial. This paper proposes a computer vision approach, leveraging computer vision and convolutional neural networks (CNNs), specifically designed for grapevine health assessment. The study employs four pre-trained CNN architecture-AlexNet, GoogleNet, ResNet and SqueezeNetusing transfer learning on dataset comprising images of three diseased grapevine leaves. The classification is achieved through a fully connected layer, and the results indicate that ResNet-18 attains the highest accuracy, demonstrating its effectiveness in identifying diseases in grapevine crops. This approach holds promise for enhancing grapevine crop management and reducing the economic burden on farmers.

articleTitle: Secure Data Transmission with Steganography
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The importance of secure and private communication and file sharing has increased in an era of escalating data security concerns. Our research aims to address this need by developing a comprehensive Secure File Sharing Application that ensures the confidentiality and integrity of shared files. It provides user registration and login functionality, allowing users to create accounts with email and password authentication. Users can choose which files to share, and the application encrypts the files using powerful encryption algorithms like AES (Advanced Encryption Standard) and RSA (Rivest-Shamir-Adleman) before sending them. Steganography techniques are used to securely embed encryption keys within innocent images, keeping them concealed from prying eyes. In order to take advantage of cloud storage's scalability and durability, encrypted files are kept in an AWS (Amazon Web Services) S3 (Simple Storage Service) bucket. Users can send the image containing the hidden decryption key to the intended recipient via email, ensuring secure transmission. The combination of Strong cryptography and steganography techniques enhances the security of the application, ensuring that only authorized recipients can access the shared content.

articleTitle: Tech-Driven Agronomy: Federated Learning CNN's for Aloe Vera Leaf Disease Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The research paper discussed how integrating a federated learning framework using a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) enables groundbreaking work in classifying aloe vera leaf diseases. The research is concerned with classifying leaf diseases into four grades, using datasets from four clients. By applying federated averaging methods, local data from each client is converted into one global unified model that preserves private information and capitalizes on collective wisdom. The result analysis offers essential findings concerning the model performance. Each client adds to the federated model uniquely, with different levels of accuracy and precision regarding disease categories. The macro, micro, and weighted averages are computed to assess the efficiency of the entire model for all customers and classes. The model for the client uj_1 has a macro average value of 78.80, a weighted average value equal to 79.25, and a micro-average of 79.36, indicating adequate initial performance. Micro, macro-averaged F1 scores of client uj_2 are 88.43 with a weighted average score at the same value. Client uj_3 refines the model's performance, scoring 90.62 in macro intermediate, 90.66 in the weighted average, and a micro according of 90. Finally, showing the exceptional performance levels is client uj_4, which attains a mean of 92.89 from macro-average, average weighted means to value at 92.0 and micro averages standing on values as high up as %. In the end, this study showed that federated learning with CNN can accurately classify aloe vera leaf diseases and establish a baseline for future research on agricultural disease management using state-of-the-art machine learning approaches.

articleTitle: Snake Species Identification Using Deep Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In order to effectively treat snakebite envenomation, which is a serious worldwide health concern, snake species identification must be done quickly and accurately. A new system uses deep learning methods more precisely, the EfficientNet-B3 model has been proposed for the identification of snake species. Improving the speed and accuracy of species recognition is the goal. The Data augmentation including rotations, flips, and scaling, enhances datasets by exposing the model to diverse conditions, thereby improving its adaptability to various scenarios. The system that is being suggested entails gathering a varied dataset that includes pictures of different kinds of snakes, nearly 135 species has been included. For feature extraction and classification, the EfficientNet-B3 model is used, which is renowned for its exceptional performance in image classification tasks.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Based Smart Contract Architecture for Inter-Domain SDN Controller Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In the realm of network management, the integration of Software-Defined Networking (SDN) with blockchain-based smart contracts is an emerging frontier with significant potential to enhance inter-domain communications. This paper presents an in-depth analysis of the application of smart contracts within SDN, particularly focusing on the automation and security of inter-domain interactions. Smart contracts, characterized by their immutable and autonomous nature, offer a novel approach to enforcing network policies and agreements across different SDN domains seamlessly. We explore the inherent benefits of this integration, including enhanced security through the tamper-proof nature of blockchain, and the efficiency gains achieved by automating network policy enforcement. The paper also addresses critical challenges such as scalability, interoperability, and the complexity of smart contract development within the SDN context. Through a combination of theoretical analysis and practical case studies, this research illuminates the transformative potential of smart contracts in SDN, paving the way for more secure, efficient, and self-regulating network environments. The findings and discussions in this paper aim to contribute to the ongoing evolution of SDN, particularly in scenarios where multiple administrative domains necessitate robust, automated, and secure communication frameworks.

articleTitle: Quantum Networking: Creating the Future Landscape of Refined Classical Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The landscape of communication sits on the edge of a quantum leap. Harnessing the paradoxical rules of quantum mechanics, quantum networks promise the ability to shatter the boundaries of traditional systems, ushering in an age of extraordinary speed, security, and computational powers. This research dives into the unexplored domain of quantum networking, clarifying its transformational potential and charting a course toward its practical realization. Crucially, the research transcends ordinary simulations by offering conceptual blueprints for a revolutionary quantum-based network architecture. This innovative concept presents entanglement distribution and quantum key distribution as applications built upon the network itself, rather than demanding bespoke network infrastructures. To painstakingly investigate this proposed model, quantum circuits were meticulously simulated, and their results juxtaposed with established quantum algorithms, revealing vital insights into its performance and potential. This research establishes the framework for the quantum Internet, not as a distant goal but as an attainable future. By delving into the integration of the proposed model with existing network topologies, the path towards a unified quantum environment is paved.
