The findings suggest favorable accuracy and efficacy of the machine learning models in identifying instances of anemia. The system's ability to leverage diverse algorithms enhances its robustness, allowing for reliable predictions across different patient profiles. This research contributes to the development of an effective and scalable anemia detection system, laying the foundation for future work in the integration of additional algorithms and optimization strategies for enhanced accuracy and clinical applicability.

articleTitle: A Survey on Blockchain in Financial Institutions
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: This paper examines the transformative impact of blockchain technology in the financial sector, exploring the advantages, challenges, and future prospects of adopting blockchain and emphasising its role in enhancing efficiency and reducing transactional costs. Also, a comparative analysis is done across various blockchain technologies that are being used in the current FinTech sector. AI-powered chatbots streamline banking, while AI is implemented in blockchain for reducing operational costs, increasing scalability and AI in decentralised finance. Also, The decentralised method of operations across the FinTech sector is explored by disrupting the intermediaries across the network and the integration of UPI in regulating compliances is also discussed. Furthermore, the research highlights ongoing efforts to address scalability, interoperability, reducing security concerns, underscoring the potential for continued evolution and innovation in financial systems.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Survey of Leaf Classification for Ayurvedic Herb Identification and Beyond
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Within the principality of herbal medicine, Ayurvedic leaves have held the commitment of healing prospects since a long period of time, providing a treasure trove of simplest medication for several affliction. In the dynamic panorama of technology, the fusion of botanical proficiency and artificial intelligence has given birth to a remarkable attempt, enabling the classification of Ayurvedic leaves with unmatched accuracy. This review paper embarks on a extensive expedition through the records of scientific exploration, delving deep into the diverse assemblage of research efforts devoted to the image classification of Ayurvedic leaves. Meticulously surveying a plethora of studies, we reveal a variety of methodologies, each a brushstroke on the canvas of herbal identification. Amongst this rich variety, two reliable algorithms, Convolutional Neural Networks and KNearest Neighbour, emerge as recurrent stars, their ubiquity and efficacy shining brightly across the literature. As the paper unfolds, their prominence becomes conspicuous, as these algorithms consistently prove their tenacity, offering robust and reliable performance in the crucial mission of Ayurvedic leaf classification. The study explores the landscape of Ayurvedic herb identification with an eye toward recognizing the leaves, providing an essential foundation for further exploration of their curative potential, fostering a bridge between tradition and innovation that holds the promise of a healthier future.

articleTitle: A Multifaceted Feature Extraction Approach for Noise-Robust Punjabi Spoken Digit Recognition System Under Low-Resource Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The development of optimal solutions in un-favourable acoustic conditions has become a crucial step in guaranteeing the durability and dependability of automated speech recognition (ASR) systems across many real-world applications. The study aims to enhance the efficiency of low-resource ASR systems in scenarios when conventional systems exhibit sub-optimal performance. The proposed methodology aims to enhance the performance of Punjabi spoken digit recognition in noisy situations with limited resources. This is achieved via the use of multidimensional feature extraction and model adapation methods. Initially, a baseline system has been developed under clean enviornmental conditions. Subsequently, a singular enhancement of a spoken digit-based system is carried out, including phonetically diverse and continuous Punjabi phrases. Moreover, research on noise augmentation demonstrate that the approaches used for feature extraction have a subtle but significant effect. The vulnerability of Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC) to noise has been found to be remarkable, however, Gammatone Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (GFCC) and the combined feature extraction approach of MFCC and GFCC (MF-GFCC) exhibit excellent resistance. The multifaceted approach undergoes a battery of rigorous tests at various noise levels, aiming to simulate the conditions often seen in real-world situations. The efficacy of the suggested enhancements has been validated by evaluating and appraising the performance evaluation metrics, the Word Error Rate (WER). The findings reveals the lower WER of 13.25% under high noise conditions and 13.30% under low noise conditions indicating not only provide valuable insights for improving speech recognition in challenging real-world situations, but also providing ramifications for various languages that have comparable limits as English.

articleTitle: Road Traffic Signal Management – A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: This research paper presents an exhaustive analysis of road traffic management, emphasizing the critical interplay between road capacity and the flow of vehicles in contemporary urban environments. It explores strategies to mitigate traffic congestion, enhance safety protocols, and optimize traffic flow dynamics. Road capacity and vehicle flow are integral components of effective traffic management systems. Through a meticulous examination of a well-defined case study, this research aims to underscore the pivotal role of efficient road traffic management systems in ameliorating traffic-related intricacies and elevating overall transportation efficacy. The selected case study serves as an exemplar, offering profound insights into various methodologies and cutting-edge technologies deployed within the traffic management domain. By dissecting the complexities inherent in this case, this research advances our comprehension of successful traffic management paradigms and provides a strategic framework for addressing analogous challenges in other urban landscapes. The discernments drawn from this study are poised to inform future urban planning endeavours and policymaking initiatives, ultimately facilitating the creation of more sustainable and seamlessly integrated transportation ecosystems.

articleTitle: Unlocking Cognitive Insights: Leveraging Transfer Learning for Caption Generation in Signed Language Videos
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The research delves into sign language recognition from video, employing a transfer learning approach. Established models like VGGNets, ResNets, DenseNet, Inception, and MobileNet are utilized to extract features from sequences of video frames. This enables the extraction of both local and global features, crucial for evaluating sign language performance. The final model utilizes an LSTM-based architecture, incorporating input from these feature sets alongside target text vectors. The analysis focuses on gesture-oriented sign language for word recognition, emphasizing the BLEU parameter. Through meticulous examination, the study pinpoints the ResNet-101 model as the most adept for the application, offering a comprehensive comprehension of sign language recognition within video contexts. This holistic approach contributes significantly to advancing the field's understanding and application, paving the way for more effective sign language recognition systems.

articleTitle: Recent Advancements in Wearable Antennas and its Future Directions
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Wireless communication has played a significant role in transferring data at higher speeds. Due to the compactness of the Antenna in terms of size at high frequency, it is possible to achieve applications in Microwave-millimeter wave bands. The super wideband antenna or multiband antenna can be designed for the Body area network but they need to have conformal characteristics. The microwave frequency bands cover the bandwidth which includes applications such as Global Position Systems(GPS), Bluetooth, ISM band, lower-upper WiMAX and WLAN bands, ultrawideband bandwidth, RADAR, and satellite applications. On the other hand, the ITU has specified FR1 and FR2 bands which include sub 6 GHz band,24 GHz,28 GHz,38GHz,39GHz,60 GHz, and 90 GHz millimeter wave bands. The conformal configuration of the Antenna is useful for body-area networks but with controllable Specific-Absorption-Rate (SAR) with minimal power input. A single antenna covering the above bandwidths either wide or narrow needs to ensure with SAR of less than equal to 1.6 W/kg for wearable applications. The MIMO configuration is really useful for gettinga high data rate and throughput with maximum SAR usinglimited to standard acceptable values and providing high directivity in the boresight direction.

articleTitle: Beyond Containers: Orchestrating Microservices with Minikube, Kubernetes, Docker, and Compose for Seamless Deployment and Scalability
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In this paper, we explore the orchestration of microservices using Minikube, Kubernetes, Docker, and Docker Compose. We discuss how these technologies enable seamless deployment and scalability of microservices architectures. Through practical examples and insights, we demonstrate the benefits of utilizing these tools in modern software development. By leveraging Minikube for local Kubernetes environments and Docker for containerization, developers can streamline their development workflow and enhance the efficiency of their deployments. Additionally, Docker Compose facilitates the management of multi-container applications, further simplifying the orchestration process. Our exploration showcases the power of these tools in enabling flexible, scalable, and resilient microservices architectures.

articleTitle: Unleashing Business Agility through Successful Business Intelligence Initiatives
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The project management approach in the software development industry has evolved in the last fifty years from a traditional to an agile approach. The agile approach not only provides better quality software products but also leads to higher customer satisfaction. There are a lot of reports and academic research highlighting the unsuccessful projects rate. The internet and globalisation have increased the amount of data, and organisations have acknowledged the need for data-driven decision-making. From this perspective, studying Agile Business Intelligence (BI) Projects and related success factors is imperative. The study is quantitative and empirical in approach. The current study empirically focuses on understanding the antecedents of Agile BI projects. The results indicate that role top management, effective team communication, frequent evaluation approach and customer satisfaction are important for Agile BI Project success.

articleTitle: Renewable Distributed Generation for Smart Highway Lighting
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Renewable energy generation is encouraging nowadays due to increasing demand day by day. At the commercial level, renewable energy generation is already in use. In this project, renewable energy generation is used on highways for lighting purposes. These energies are already wasted on highways by constructively using them, it can convert traditional highways into smart highways. The project consists combination of three energies, i.e. solar, wind, and piezoelectric energy. Many projects are already running on the highway in which individual energy or a combination of two energy is used for the generation. Still, with this project, three hybrid energy generation systems will be explained for the lighting on the highways. Initially, this system can cost more, but in the long term, it benefits more as well. This off-grid system can also further extend to supply back to the grid if satisfy the current usage on the highway.

articleTitle: SDG 4 Progression through Mobile Learning:An Exploratory Study of Indian HEIs
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Mobile learning(M-Learning) has emerged as a powerful tool, bridging gaps in accessibility, enhancing the quality of education, promoting lifelong learning, fostering sustainability and innovation, and facilitating efficient monitoring and assessment. However, higher education institutions (HEls), government bodies and administrators must frame constructive policies to implement M-Learning in higher education successfully. This paper explores how M-Learning is reshaping higher education in India, aligning with the Sustainable Development Goal 4(SDG 4) objectives and contributing to the nation's educational development. The study involved interviews of teachers in universities in Tier I cities in India. The authors have applied purposive sampling and selected teachers having at least five years' experience of teaching students online. The study indicated that teachers must embed mobile learning as a supplementary tool in their courses and in the teaching and learning pedagogies that they apply. The findings will be helpful touniversities in higher education and their teachers who can design a blended learning approach to embed mobile learning in their courses. The study will be useful to policymakers in education sector to analyzerole of mobile learning in the attainment ofSDG 4. The research will guide HEls in the attainment of SDG4.

articleTitle: Analyzing Gold Price Movements: A Comprehensive Supervised Learning Perspective
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The given study explores the use of machine learning algorithms in the commodity trading scenario, specifically for gold trading. In theory, such tasks need to be accomplished with the help regression models. Taking it into the practice, implementation of various algorithms, along with testing and comparison among the models has been indicated. Linear, Multiple KNN, Decision Tree, Random Forest and Support Vector Regressions and the feed-forward neural network Multi-Layer Perceptron Regression were applied on the 3 datasets of gold price. The datasets are set in the time period and specify day-wise, week-wise and month-wise time intervals. In this work, it is inferred that neural network-based model MLP is outperforming the other basic and conventional models in terms of MAPE, MSE, RMSE and R2 score.

articleTitle: Refining Language Translator Using Indepth Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: While significant strides have been made in machine translation, persistent challenges persist in handling nuances, contextual intricacies, and cultural subtleties. This study introduces a multifaceted approach using advanced machine learning algorithms to elevate translation precision. By integrating techniques such as stemming, statistical machine translation, sentiment analysis, attention mechanisms, and domain-specific fine-tuning, tangible enhancements in both accuracy and fluency are achieved. The outcomes showcase notable improvements in BLEU and ROUGE scores, coupled with an enhanced ability to capture sentiment nuances and domain-specific expertise, validated by favorable assessments from human evaluators. This research marks a transformative leap toward translations that transcend mere linguistic barriers, extending to encompass emotional and cultural dimensions. It heralds a future characterized by seamless and expressive cross-linguistic communication.

articleTitle: Cardiovascular Disease Prediction Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Cardiovascular disease (CVD), ahead of all other causes of death worldwide in this era. There is an immediate need for accurate, reliable, and practically applicable ways of early detection and treatment of diseases, and it connects a number of hazards for cardiovascular disease. One common method for analyzing massive amounts of historical information in healthcare is data extraction. To assist physicians with CVD prediction, they employ a number of data mining and deep learning (DL) techniques to navigate complex medical data. This review paper critically examines the application of deep learning techniques in predicting cardiovascular diseases, emphasizing data collection, preprocessing, model selection, performance metrics, and challenges. The data-driven nature of DL models allows for the analysis of diverse patient information, contributing to more accurate risk assessments. The review achieves by discussing the challenges and limitations, emphasizing the importance of collaborative efforts to connect DL's potential in enhancing cardiovascular disease prediction and improving patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Advanced Deep Learning Integration for IoT Ecosystem for Content Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The incorporation of sophisticated deep learning methods into the IoT ecosystem has great potential for improving content categorization skills in different IoT applications. This abstract presents a summary of the approaches, difficulties, and possible advantages linked to this integration. In the domain of IoT, a substantial volume of data is produced by sensors, devices, and other sources, requiring effective techniques for handling and examining this data. Deep learning is a strong method for content categorization in IoT contexts because it can automatically build hierarchical representations of data. The paper explores the essential elements of incorporating deep learning into the IoT ecosystem for content classification. These components include acquiring and preprocessing data, selecting and training models, performing edge computing and inference, optimizing models, enabling continuous learning and adaptation, and addressing security and privacy concerns. Moreover, it emphasizes the need for a smooth interface with IoT platforms and apps to allow developers to fully use these enhanced capabilities. Developers may simplify the process of deploying and using deep learning models for AI-powered IoT applications by using APIs, SDKs, and libraries. The incorporation of sophisticated deep learning methods into the IoT ecosystem for content categorization can transform a range of IoT applications, such as smart cities, industrial automation, healthcare, and others. This connection facilitates intelligent decision-making, automation, and optimization, hence creating a more efficient, responsive, and intelligent IoT infrastructure.

articleTitle: Exploring Transfer Learning in Brain Tumor Classification with Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In today's era, medical advancements have reached their peak but still, some bugs led to the emergence and involvement of advanced techniques like Machine learning, Artificial Intelligence, and Deep Learning. These three are interconnected and have strong relationships that work as such, to increase the growth of work in any domain with rapid accuracy and without any error. This paper deals with the identification and categorization of tumors. Brain tumors are a result of abnormal behavior of cell division which leads to uncontrolled growth of cells and results in the formation of masses and lumps in the brain. The detection of tumors is done using radiology with the help of MRI techniques or MRI scans. Traditional scans sometimes lead to errors causing misdiagnoses. This process is also timeconsuming and as such requires high expertise. To elevate this process, in this paper, we used a multi-layered CNN model which takes the MRI images as input and classifies it into one of the four major categories i.e., ‘Glioma’, ‘Meningioma’, ‘Pituitary’ or ‘No Tumor’. The publicly available dataset used to train this model contains over 7000 images which have been segregated into testing and training where both classes contain 4 different segmentations depicting the different brain tumors. The training folder contains nearly 5200 images, and the testing folder has over 1500 images. The accuracy of the model has been tested to over 96 percent. Then we converted the above model to the VGG16 model by using the study of Transfer Learning and the model gave up to 98.04% accuracy and validation accuracy was approximately 94.73%.

articleTitle: Efficient Solar Panel Maintenance: A Data-Driven Strategy using Ant Colony Optimization and Innovative Cleaning Index
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Addressing the pivotal challenge of enhancing power output in solar power plants through optimized cleaning schedules, this research introduces an innovative cleaning index. This index, which encompasses power output, cleaning penalties, and associated costs, becomes the focal point for the Ant Colony Optimization (ACO) algorithm to devise adaptive and efficient cleaning schedules. Leveraging a data-driven approach with an extensive dataset encompassing solar panel output voltage and environmental variables, the study seamlessly integrates ACO to navigate the intricate solution space. The proposed cleaning index not only acts as a sophisticated evaluation tool but also aligns with the dynamic nature of solar energy production. This research makes a significant contribution by providing a comprehensive view of cleaning schedule efficiency and showcasing the adaptability of ACO in response to dynamic environmental conditions. Real-world applicability is underscored by incorporating actual data, ensuring practical relevance and reliability. The study's findings offer actionable insights for optimizing solar panel performance, leading to reduced operational costs and minimized environmental impact. In conclusion, this work propels the field forward by presenting a robust and practical framework for the optimization of solar panel cleaning, promising substantial advancements in efficiency and sustainability within solar power generation.

articleTitle: Securing lOT Devices and Networks with Role of Cryptography
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: “Things” are physical items that are network-connected and can transmit, receive, and gather data. The Internet of Things (loT) refers to this concept. This goes beyond the “internet of virtual things” that we currently use to refer to web sites, videos, and other online information. Devices in the Internet of Things paradigm are outfitted with sensors that collect environmental data. After processing, the data is transferred via the Internet to be kept on servers that resemble cloud infrastructure. Once stored, the data is analyzed to derive actionable insights, potentially leading to automation or improvements in human life. However, with the rapid proliferation of loT devices, there are rising concerns over data security. While many focus on software security, hardware-level security is equally crucial. This article proposes embedding a crypto module in loT devices to bolster security right from data collection, ensuring that data is securely transmitted and stored. The proposed model has been observed to compute results with accuracy up to 98.6%. Our model integrates a crypto engine tailored for loT, ensuring robust data encryption and seamless integration across loT architectures. By bridging the physical and digital realms, it guarantees data security, authenticity, and integrity, addressing the pressing challenges of the burgeoning loT ecosystem.

articleTitle: Enhancing Exercise Form: A Pose Estimation Approach with Body Landmark Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: As the integration of technology in fitness becomes increasingly prevalent, our study addresses the vital aspect of exercise form through the lens of pose estimation. Employing a body landmark detection model, we devised an algorithm to accurately identify key body landmarks and their correctness in posture during exercises. This paper presents a comprehensive exploration of our methodology, emphasizing the algorithmic estimation of user poses based on the detected landmarks. Our approach enables real-time monitoring of exercise forms and provides instant critique to users on the correctness of their posture. The applications extend beyond mere tracking, fostering an interactive environment where users actively engage in perfecting their form throughout their workout sessions. This paper culminates with discerning observations into the potential future developments, emphasizing the need for more detailed landmark detection models to identify intuitive landmarks. This research contributes to the evolving landscape of technology-assisted fitness, offering a promising avenue for personalized and effective exercise routines.

articleTitle: Disease Detection of Plant Leaf Using Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Plant disease detection is currently approached from a different angle in this research, which advocates for a model built in Keras with a TensorFlow backend that uses transfer learning. This paper aims to develop an efficient system for the timely detection and classification of plant leaf diseases caused by bacterial, viral, or fungal infections. The suggested system makes use of convolutional neural networks (CNNs), a type of deep learning technique. Accurate leaf disease classification is achieved through the use of CNNs and transfer learning. To validate and train the CNN, a dataset of plant leaves with both normal and infected specimens is used. The trained model is expected to classify plant leaf diseases with an accuracy of 96.20%, demonstrating the efficacy of transfer learning in CNN-based image classification tasks. The proposed system gives farmers the ability to identify plant leaf diseases early on, which is useful in practical situations and allows for prompt intervention. Furthermore, a web application is created with the FLASK API that lets users submit an image of a sample leaf and get back information about the health of the plant.

articleTitle: Speech Emotion Recognition using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) is an emerging field that involves recognizing emotions conveyed in speech. Emotions expressed through speech can greatly impact decision-making. This paper delves into the topic of speech emotion recognition (SER) and its focus on interpreting emotions conveyed through spoken language. The importance of SER lies in its potential to improve human-computer interaction, cognitive analysis, and psychiatric assessment. The study combines and preprocesses audio data from various datasets, such as RAVDESS, CREMA-D, TESS, and SAVEE, and uses log mel spectrograms to effectively extract features. Various methods including CNN models, and standard and optimized feature extraction techniques are used. The results suggest that SER has significant real-world applications and the approaches provided effectively identify emotional and voice signals.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis Unleashed: Leveraging VADER for Evaluation of Public Opinion
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Digital reviews provide real-world feedback on products and services in an era of online commerce and access to information. Providing feedback fosters trust and credibility among potential customers, enabling them to make informed purchasing decisions. In review classification, sentiment analysis is a key component that assesses the emotional tone of the reviews. Businesses can prioritize responses, manage their reputation, and extract actionable insights by categorizing reviews as positive, negative, or neutral. The study also includes neutral feedback, which includes suggestions for incremental improvement, which assists in continuous product refinement. In the proposed work, more than 5,68,455 reviews are divided into positive negative, and neutral sentiments by sentiment analysis. The results demonstrate VADER's robustness and versatility, showing its capacity to accurately gauge public sentiment across different contexts and types of language, including slang, emojis, and colloquial expressions. We also compare VADER's performance with other sentiment analysis algorithms, underscoring its advantages in handling informal online communication.

articleTitle: Predictive Analytics for Antibiotic Resistance Mitigation in Cloud-Powered Healthcare Systems Using Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Innovative antibiotic resistance mitigation measures are needed to protect world health. This research examines how cloud-powered healthcare systems might improve antibiotic resistance management using predictive analytics. A strong prediction model for antibiotic resistance trends is created using cloud-stored patient data and the Random Forest algorithm. The model analyzes relevant aspects using varied clinical and demographic information. The study uses a cloud-based infrastructure to scale and access patient information and antibiotic consumption trends. Random Forest's ensemble learning method accurately predicts antibiotic resistance development from complicated data linkages. The model's performance is rigorously tested and compared to older approaches. Results show that the suggested technique may identify antibiotic resistance tendencies early, giving healthcare professionals useful information for preemptive action. The cloud-based approach allows real-time data processing and decision-making. The model's interpretability helps healthcare providers identify reasons for resistance and develop focused interventions. By using cloud technologies and powerful machine learning to mitigate antibiotic resistance, this research advances healthcare analytics. The results show that predictive analytics may improve healthcare and emphasize the need for a proactive, data-driven antibiotic resistance strategy.

articleTitle: Analytical Approach Towards Cybersecurity Through AI-Enabled Threat Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: A growing variety of cyber hazards are appearing as the world becomes more and more digital. The sophistication and rate of innovation of emerging threats puts organizations of all sizes at danger, and traditional cybersecurity solutions frequently fall short of keeping up. Threat intelligence powered by artificial intelligence, or AI-TI, offers a fresh and cutting-edge method for tackling cybersecurity issues. To find patterns and anomalies that could point to a cyber-attack, AI-TI solutions can examine massive amounts of data from a variety of sources, including as internal networks, security logs, and open threat intelligence feeds. Then, with the use of this information, security teams can be made aware of prospective dangers and assist in the creation of defense measures. Compared to conventional cybersecurity solutions, AI-TI systems have a number of benefits: Automation: AI-TI systems have the potential to automate a number of threat detection and response-related duties, freeing up security staff to concentrate on more strategic projects. Continuous improvement: AI-TI systems have the ability to continuously learn and get better with time, which enables them to stay on top of the most recent threats. Advanced threat detection: AI-TI systems can be used to identify and react to threats that are too sophisticated or subtle for traditional approaches to identify.

articleTitle: An Extrinsic LiDAR-GNSS/INS Registration Approach for Autonomous Driving
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Ensuring precise registration of sensors stands as a pivotal element in integrating LiDAR and inertial data for autonomous driving. This study introduces an innovative three-phase method for extrinsic registration among GNSS/INS and LiDAR systems in the scenarios of autonomous vehicles. The initial phase rapidly refines extrinsic parameters among sensors by utilizing point cloud surface features, swiftly narrowing down the initial large error to a significantly smaller range. Subsequently, the second phase further refines these parameters by considering LiDAR-mapping space occupancy while eliminating any distortion caused by motion. The concluding phase rectifies z-axis errors attributed to the vehicle's plane motion, resulting in the attainment of precise extrinsic parameters. Notably, our method leverages planar environmental features, facilitating swift registration procedures. Evaluation on real-world datasets substantiates the reliability and accuracy of this approach.

articleTitle: A Framework for Blockchain-Enabled Smart Contract Management System of Arms and Ammunition for Defence Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: This paper presents an innovative solution, the Blockchain-Enabled Smart Contract- Based Management System for Arms & Ammunition, revolutionizing logistics within the Defence industry. Addressing prevalent challenges of transparency limitations and manual inefficiencies in existing systems, this framework represents a transformative approach. Leveraging blockchain technology and smart contracts, our framework offers real-time visibility, automated processes, and stringent compliance measures. The architectural design incorporates distinct layers including Blockchain Network, Smart Contracts, Data Management, User Interfaces, Integration, Security, and Governance. Smart contracts play a pivotal role by ensuring data accuracy and enabling immediate access to critical information. Scalability concerns are mitigated through optimized consensus algorithms and sharding, ensuring smooth expansion. An indepth analysis of blockchain platforms underscores the significance of platform selection, pivotal for security and operational efficiency. Real-world use cases illustrate the system's adaptability, spanning ammunition distribution to proactive maintenance scheduling, showcasing its resilience and versatility. In summary, our proposed system marks a monumental advancement in Defence industry logistics, offering unparalleled transparency, automation, and security. It sets a new standard for military operations by establishing a robust and responsive infrastructure. Ongoing developmental initiatives and global collaboration underscore a future-ready, secure, and adaptable Defence landscape.

articleTitle: Improved Image Caption Generation With GPT-3 And Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Subtitling, a growing field of natural language processing (NLP) research, includes generating a caption representation of images. The major goal is to use the pre-trained convolutional neural network (CNN) to develop a mechanism to caption an image. Convolutional neural network helps in feature extraction in this study whereas the extracted features are utilized by Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) to subtitle the captions for images. To encode the image several convolutional neural network pre-trained models are used. The decoder, a GPT -3-based language model, constructs descriptive sentences. In addition, adding Bahdanau's attention model to GPT -3 improves performance by enabling targeted learning in specific image regions. In an empirical evaluation of the MSCOCO dataset, our approach shows competitive performance.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Methods in Non-Invasive Detection of Iron Deficiency
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Anaemia is a condition in which there is a lack of red blood cells in the bloodstream. The goal of this study is to develop a model for predicting anaemia in human beings using Complete Blood Count results. Diagnosing anaemia usually involves examining the colour distribution of the palpebral conjunctiva; a blood test is not necessary for this process. Nevertheless, since individual colour perception varies, we try to mimic the physical inspection of the palpebral conjunctiva to identify anaemia. This way computers may automatically identify anaemia patients in a consolidated manner for a screening procedure. The approach employed in this study is separated into three phases: gathering the datasets, which is the eye (conjunctiva), pre-processing the picture, which includes segmentation of formican & palpebral area. We make use of a thresholding decision method that is based on the high hue rate (HHR) feature, which is taken from the HIS colour space. As such, diagnosing anaemia with low-cost, non-invasive techniques remains a difficulty. One can determine whether a patient has anaemia by looking at the pallor of their palms, fingers, nail beds and conjunctiva. In order to overcome the aforementioned issues, this paper presents a unique intelligent system that helps the automated detection of anaemia and is built on machine learning. As a result, we suggest an algorithm that adopts a more thorough methodology. It includes a wide range of features, two based on colour and one texture. To improve accuracy and dependability, it also used a more advanced classifier, like an artificial neural network (ANN) or support vector machine (SVM). Even though it takes more time and processing resources, this approach priorities precision and resilience, making it appropriate for applications where precise categorization is required.

articleTitle: Navigating Urban Mobility: A Review of AI-Driven Traffic Flow Management in Smart Cities
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In the current period of growing urbanization and aspirations towards smart cities, urban transportation is a considerable difficulty. Conventional traffic management systems are finding it difficult to remain sustainable and efficient in the face of increasing vehicle traffic and population density. In response, a thorough analysis of AI-driven traffic flow management systems designed for smart cities is carried out in this research. These systems use artificial intelligence (AI) to improve overall transportation efficiency, lessen traffic congestion, and optimize traffic flow. The study includes a survey of the literature that has already been written, emphasizing the technology, methodology, and case studies that are influencing the field of AI-driven traffic management. Artificial intelligence (AI) traffic prediction algorithms, realtime data integration, dynamic routing schemes, and control and monitoring user interfaces are important parts. The review delves at issues including interoperability, scalability, and ethical considerations related to the application of AI in urban settings. This study provides important insights into the possibilities and constraints of AI-driven traffic flow management systems, which may help academics, policymakers, and urban planners develop more sustainable and effective urban transportation networks. One of the most important aspects of developing smart cities is the effective control of urban traffic flow. The intricacies of contemporary metropolitan surroundings are frequently too much for traditional traffic management systems to handle, which causes delays, congestion, and environmental issues. To maximize urban mobility in smart cities, this study presents a unique traffic flow management system driven by artificial intelligence.

articleTitle: Empowering Agriculture with Smart Energy Management: A Roadmap to Enhanced Productivity
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The increasing global population is accompanied by a corresponding rise in the demand for food and agricultural resources. In the present situation, it is of utmost importance to prioritize the establishment of sustainability and efficiency in agricultural production. This study presents a complete methodology for enabling the agricultural sector to leverage smart energy management techniques, thereby providing a strategic framework for improving production and optimizing resource allocation. The core of this strategy is centered around the notion of Energy of Things (EOT), an emerging paradigm that utilizes the Internet of Things (IoT) to enhance the efficiency of energy usage and distribution within agricultural settings. The use of EOT (Internet of Things) technology is implemented in order to effectively oversee and regulate diverse facets of agricultural activities, encompassing irrigation systems, machinery operations, and lighting mechanisms. This integration of EOT technology results in enhanced utilization of resources and augmented crop productivity. In this study, we propose the integration of EOT (Evolutionary Optimization Technique) with intelligent resource allocation to develop a comprehensive system that can effectively respond to fluctuating environmental circumstances, varying resource availability, and diverse crop requirements. This integrated system aims to achieve optimal usage of resources for agricultural purposes. This study examines the fundamental elements and advantages of the proposed system, with a particular focus on its capacity to transform the agricultural sector and promote sustainable food production.

articleTitle: Advancements in Offline Handwriting-Based Language Recognition: A Comprehensive Review for Indic Scripts
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Text recognition is essential to Natural Language Processing (NLP) and the digitization process. These systems play a crucial role in addressing the limitations of non-editable documents in the process of digitalization. Additionally, they have significant applications in various fields, including the financial sector, the medical field, the field of machine translation, digital libraries, and many more. Furthermore, due to the pandemic, there has been a surge in the volume of digital data within the education industry, hence requiring the implementation of text recognition systems to manage it effectively. Text recognition systems were designed to process three distinct forms of text: (a) machine-printed text, (b) offline handwritten text, and (c) online handwritten text. This review focuses primarily on exploring the functionality of Offline Handwritten Text (OHT) Recognition systems. The analysis revealed 23 articles that focused only on the recognition of Indian language text within the timeframe spanning from 2018 to 2023. Convergence has a significant obstacle in the form of limited access to historical documents and other conventional resources across various text formats. Although this research investigates all Indian languages, the Hindi language/Devanagari script is the primary emphasis. This study comprehensively examines all existing text recognition methods for Indian scripts. Furthermore, the assessment of textual recognition work across multiple Indian languages is conducted using various metrics, i.e., accuracy, precision, Fmeasure, etc.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning and Optimization Techniques in Chest X-ray Image Analysis for Medical Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Nowadays, pneumonia, lung cancer, and COVID-19 are the main causes of death, particularly in developing nations. Even if far less advanced instruments and therapies are used to identify and cure illness. The detection of these diseases remains a main alarm in developing nations. This paper offers multiple disease detection by using optimized machine learning methods and a heuristic algorithm. Various complications and characteristics are also described for the disease. The proposed methodology positively described various machine learning methods such as KNN, support vector machine (SVM), Logistic Regression (LR), Random Forest (RF), and RBM, etc. It also includes adaptive and altruistic PSO (AAPSO) and heuristic red fox optimization (HRFO) methods for the classification and optimization process of pneumonia, Covid-19, and lung cancer. The overall analysis of this methodology, the adaptive and altruistic PSO method reached better performance as compared to other methods

articleTitle: Tuning of Machine Learning Model to Strengthen the Digital Ecosystem of Vehicular Ad-hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The paper presents an attempt to improve cybersecurity by optimizing machine learning methods. In the process, authors present a dynamic method that enhances these algorithms, leading to a better accuracy in threat identification. This improves the security of digital ecosystems and provides information on how cybersecurity techniques are changing. The authors offer an in-depth analysis of security risks in vehicular ad hoc networks (VANETs) by dividing data into “attack,” “moderate attack,” and “no attack” segments using Mean Square Error (MSE). This method determines the impact and seriousness of the threats. Our work provides detailed insights for proactive security in VANETs by using MSE as a labelling technique. To enhance threat assessment, a rating system for vehicles is also introduced. This system assesses vehicle behavior and performance within VANETs using the Levenberg algorithm. By examining service measurements, a rank is assigned to every vehicle, signifying its influence on cybersecurity and network performance. The effectiveness of threat detection is examined using performance metrics demonstrating nearly 4% enhancement in threat detection accuracy. This combined strategy raises individual vehicle contributions to QoS in VANETs, boosts threat detection, and offers insights into the health of the network.

articleTitle: Evolving Perspectives: Exploring Accessibility and Inclusivity in Spatial UI/UX
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In the realm of spatial UI/UX design, the imperative for accessibility and inclusivity is paramount. This research elucidates the profound benefits that arise from integrating real-time subtitles in digital interfaces, primarily as an aid for individuals who are deaf or hard of hearing. As a salient example of people-centered design, real-time subtitles serve a transformative dual purpose; they provide an essential communicative bridge for the deaf and simultaneously facilitate cross-linguistic exchanges amongst general users.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Small-Cap Equity Mutual Fund Using Data Mining Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: This research paper focuses on the performance evaluation of small-cap equity mutual funds with the help of data mining techniques. The study aims to leverage advanced statistical methods to assess and predict the effectiveness of small-cap equity funds in the financial market. Mutual funds are a secure medium for Indian investors to participate in Indian financial markets. Performance is a key indicator for the mobilization of savings into these mutual funds. The main purpose of this paper is to build a mutual fund performance evaluation model by using the Statistical Package for the Social Science (SPSS) statistics software platform. In this paper, the evaluation is restricted to small-cap equity mutual funds. This study covers top-rated funds in the small-cap category with the validation study period of the last fifteen years from April 2007 to March 2021. Through this analysis, the paper seeks to provide valuable insights for investors and fund managers, enabling informed decision-making in the context of small-cap equity mutual fund investments. The results of this paper aim to contribute to the ongoing discourse on fund evaluation methodologies and enhance the understanding of factors influencing the performance of small-cap equity funds.

Author Keywords: Statistical Package for the Social Science (SPSS)

articleTitle: Aloe Vera Leaf Diseases Pathology: Harnessing Federated Learning CNNs for Enhanced Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: This research paper proposes a novel technique that utilizes the federated learning framework and convolutional neural networks (CNN) to identify aloe vera leaf diseases. The study targets five main species of aloe vera leaf diseases using data from clients in about five countries. The ultimate goal is to use federated learning techniques for aggregation while achieving data privacy and minimizing the need for centralized data when the model is rigorously tested using precision, recall, and F1-score. Support and accuracy metrics to calculate its performance The clients effectively detected disease to different degrees, which indicates a geographically heterogeneous manifestation of the said condition. The performance metrics across the clients were as follows: Precision, recall F1-score and accuracy of 81.54%, 81.59 %, and 80% were demonstrated by the client. The precision, recall, F1-score and accuracy of the client rj_2 were 79.03% and 79.19%, respectively, as well as a total of precisely The precision, recall f-score, and accuracy scores for the client rj_3 were 87.05%, followed by 87.10%, followed up with 87.07%, and finally ending at 95%. Secondly, the investigation focused on evaluating federated averaging for model aggregation using local client data and comparing it with global aggregate data. The analysis revealed a progressive enhancement in model accuracy and reliability, as evidenced by the average performance metrics: Macro averages were 81.56% (rj_1) and 90.02% (rj_5). The weighted average scores ranged from 81.63% (rj_1) to 90.01% (rj_5). The micro averages went from 81.59% (rj_1) to 90.02% (rj_5). These findings support the model's ability to respond to region-specific diseases and improve its performance by employing federated learning. The approach is instrumental in agricultural settings where the data are fragmented and heterogeneous.

articleTitle: Automated Diabetic Retinopathy Detection Using Multi-Column Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) remains a significant public health concern, necessitating early detection to mitigate vision impairment in individuals with diabetes. This research investigates the effectiveness and challenges of employing Multi-Column Deep Neural Networks (MC-DNNs) for automated diabetic retinopathy detection, addressing a critical need for early intervention in diabetes-related eye complications. Leveraging a diverse dataset of retinal images annotated for varying diabetic retinopathy severity levels. Through rigorous training and validation processes, the MC-DNN demonstrates promising results in terms of sensitivity, specificity, and overall accuracy. The model's interpretability is analyzed, shedding light on its decision-making process and providing qualitative insights into its diagnostic capabilities. The findings underscore the potential clinical impact of automated detection, particularly in aiding healthcare professionals with timely and precise interventions. The study also delves into the challenges faced during the implementation of MC-DNNs in diabetic retinopathy detection. Addressing issues related to model interpretability, dataset biases, and potential confounding factors is crucial for ensuring the responsible and ethical deployment of AI in clinical settings.

articleTitle: Three-Tier Survey of Deep Learning Based Traffic Prediction Schemes
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In the era of big data, traffic prediction, along with deep learning, has gained attention in previous years. Urban planners have long been concerned by the constant challenges of precisely forecasting traffic patterns. Conventional approaches, which mainly depends on statistical models, continually fails to accurately capture the dynamic and complex nature of vehicular traffic. These techniques encounters difficulties in fully encompassing the complex aspects that influence traffic dynamics. This study explores into the revolutionary potential of deep learning to address the limitations of existing methodologies, notably in addressing the intrinsic complexity of traffic forecast. We explore three different deep learning approaches - Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN), and a mix of both known as Hybrid. This review analyses their utility in decoding spatial and temporal complexities important for attaining accurate prediction. This research also emphasis on most frequently used datasets, acting as benchmark for assessing the robustness of traffic prediction models. This study seeks to impact the direction of future breakthroughs in applying deep learning to traffic prediction, adding to the ongoing refinement of its dynamic sphere. In the end we have highlighted some research challenges and future scope for the readers.

articleTitle: Authentication for Online Fraud Detection Through Hidden Markov Model
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In this work, investigate the feasibility of employing a Hidden Markov model for Image Click Point Authentication. The focus of this research is on finding a way to generate a password from just four select-able areas of an image. Users must verify their identities before gaining entry to protected locations. Password-based authentication is by far the most widespread method. Attackers can easily figure out a user's text-based password by using social E-commerce tactics. These days, the internet is used for everything. Online shopping's popularity has exploded in recent years. The term “e-commerce” refers to the practice of conducting business transactions (such as retail shopping) electronically over the Internet. Credit cards have quickly become the preferred mode of payment for both online and in-person purchases. As the use of credit cards for internet purchases grows more commonplace, so does credit card theft. In this study, we use a Hidden Markov Model to simulate the steps of a credit card transaction (HMM). A user's identity can be checked by having them click on specific spots within a moving image on the screen at specific intervals. With graphical authentication, the user creates a sequence string by clicking on different areas of an image. After the algorithm has decided that an attack is very likely, the compromised account will be immediately disabled.

articleTitle: DeepFake Video Detection Using Machine Learning and Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The current issue facing the community is determining the legitimacy of online content, including movies and pictures generated by machine learning, in light of the development of Generative adversarial networks (GAN) and other deep learning-based DeepFake approaches. There is an extraordinary chance that we may severe violations of fundamental human rights combined with an inevitable, fundamental shift in the way people interact in society. Evidence of misinformation and manipulation of news headlines, medical (dis)information, and invasions of privacy have already been demonstrated. The objective of this proposed project is to efficiently identify DeepFake photos using an online image database. The categorization of real from false photos using convolutional neural networks and data from a sizable internet database is the main topic of this study. Our comparison of three distinct convolutional neural networks was our goal. 1) DenseNet, 2) VGG Face and 3) personalized CNN structure. Future research will examine whether real and false pictures cluster independently using unsupervised clustering techniques or auto-encoders. It would also involve using CNN visualization techniques to give our models more interpretability and transparency.

articleTitle: Enhancing Traffic Management Using Deep Learning for Realtime Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In this modern era, the use of vehicles is increasing tremendously due to the increase in the population. The escalating issue of traffic congestion has emerged as a critical challenge in the real world. We currently face a lack of viable solutions to efficiently manage and alleviate traffic-related issues. In the event of an accident, our ability to swiftly locate the incident and initiate requisite actions is hindered by existing constraints, contributing to delays in addressing the situation effectively. The delay in finding what the incident is and locating the problem results in the increased severity of the situation. In response to these challenges, we have devised a solution through deep learning models. Upon the occurrence of an incident, our system promptly dispatches immediate alerts to authorized personnel, and checks for the manipulation of the traffic signals, facilitating a faster and more efficient response. Therefore, action could be taken at the same time as the incident, which will reduce the impact of the situation.

articleTitle: A ResNet-101 Based Recommendation System for E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In today's connected world, where users have millions of choices on online platforms, recommendation systems play an important role in personalizing experiences. Traditionally, recommendation systems are created by utilizing collaborative or content-based filtering; however, both do not utilize visual aspects of items, which playa very important role in helping users to make decisions. With advances in deep learning techniques, image processing and extracting valuable information from images using convolutional neural networks are becoming easier and efficient. Therefore, images of items can provide very accurate and important auxiliary information for recommendation systems to utilize and make more accurate recommendations. This paper proposes a ResNet-lOl based recommendation system which considers the visual aspects as well as the metadata of items to increase the rating prediction performance of already existing recommendation algorithms. This paper also proposes a way through which recommendations could be generated by utilizing predicted ratings.

articleTitle: Design and Development of a QR-Based Automated Form Filling Application
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Exploring the innovative realm of QR technology, this research delves into the design and feasibility of an automated form-filling application. In an era increasingly embracing digitalization and environmental mindfulness, the study responds to the critical need for efficient, paperless solutions in form filling. Employing a comprehensive methodology encompassing requirement analysis, market research, risk assessment, UI/UX design, and skill development, the project leverages QR codes to revolutionize traditional form-filling processes. Beyond technical optimization, the study envisions a future where QR technology not only ensures streamlined processes but also contributes significantly to global sustainability goals by minimizing paper usage. The once humble QR codes emerge as powerful catalysts for a more efficient, sustainable, and digitally empowered administrative landscape.

articleTitle: The Evolution of Labor Market: A Blockchain Based Decentralized Hiring System for Efficient Labor Acquisition
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The significant impact that technological advancement has had on the evolution of the labour market has led to the emergence of innovative and imaginative approaches to hiring more workers more effectively. In order to address the issues with the current job market, this essay suggests a novel approach to hiring that is decentralised and blockchain-based. The proposed method increases labour procurement's efficacy and efficiency by leveraging blockchain technology's decentralisation, transparency, and immutability. Rather than using middlemen like traditional job boards or recruiting agencies, this approach eliminates middlemen by connecting companies and job seekers directly through blockchain technology. Smart contract automation of the hiring process guarantees the safe implementation of employment terms and conditions. The de centralised nature of the system ensures that individuals from all around the world can find work, and employers can locate talent from all over the world. Furthermore, the system ensures that both companies and job seekers have credible profiles by incorporating reputation management into a de centralised identification system. This helps to reduce problems caused by dishonesty or misrepresentation of qualifications. Furthermore, the entire process incorporates a grading and feedback system, allowing participants to assess one another's trustworthiness and performance, resulting in better hiring decisions.

articleTitle: Advanced Encryption for Enhanced Data Protection for Heterogeneous Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In Wireless Sensory Networks (WSNs) a pivotal role will be in collection and disseminating process of sensitive data across various applications of domains, ranges from healthcare to industrial automation process. However, the inherently vulnerabilities to wireless communication as it exposes these networks to a potential security threat. In response to the challenges, the current research proposes a robust and adaptable encryption supportive system. By leveraging renowned Rivest Cipher mechanism, to enhances data protection in WSNs. The proposed system is named as RivaDataGuard which integrates the time-tested Rivest Cipher algorithm for providing a formidable defensive process against unauthorized access and data breaches. It is known that Rivest Cipher for its strength in confidentiality and data-integrity to ensures a secured communication channel within the WSN infrastructure. It will employ a dynamically varying management system, facilitating the generation and distribution of cryptographically generated keys to Sensory nodes. This dynamic approach will enhance the system's resilience to attacks by ensuring that even if one Nodal point will be in malicious behavioral, the overall network performance will remain secure. This adaptability of Proposed methodology will not only optimize performance but also it minimizes power consumption which is a crucial factor for resource-constrained Sensory nodes. For performance evaluation, the proposed system will undergo a rigorous testing and evaluation for validating its effectiveness in dynamically varying scenarios.

articleTitle: Federated Learning CNN for Broccoli Leaf Disease Control: A Path to Sustainable Farming
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: A federated learning approach using convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for broccoli leaves' disease classification is described in our study. Here are a few highlights from the article. Using input from five varied clients, each representing a different cultivation scenario, we tackle the difficult task of classifying five separate classes of broccoli leaf diseases: healthy leaves, downy mildew, Alternaria leaf spot, black rot, and ring spot. On average, our federated learning CNN model reached an accuracy of 94.02%, recall of 94.54%, and F1-Score of 96.15%, proving its effectiveness. These results show that our federated learning model was able to provide an accurate classification of the five classes of broccoli leaf diseases. The model was able to identify standard features such as color, size, and shape to differentiate different courses. The weighted average, considering client performance and dataset sizes, equates to an F1-Score of 96.20%, a recall value of 94.53%, and precision at the said percentile was rounded up. In addition, considering all the clients and data sizes within dataset management, it does not miss out on accuracy, which stands at 94.03%, recall that is put up for standardization at 94.52%, and an F1-Score of 96%. These comprehensive results demonstrate that our federated learning model consistently and robustly classifies broccoli leaf diseases through diverse cultivation scenarios. This reinforces the ability of federated learning to overcome agricultural issues without compromising data confidentiality.

articleTitle: Transforming Sugarcane Leaf Diseases Pathology with Convolutional Neural Networks and SVM
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: This paper has provided, in detail, a complete study of the application of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) together with support vector machines for the classification of multiple classes of sugarcane leaf disease In sugarcane cultivation, where early and accurate diagnosis of diseases is considered essential for optimal agricultural productivity, the study describes a novel AI-based method to detect and classify leaf disease that aims at improving crop health management. Each disease class was evaluated using precision, recall, F1-score support proportion and accuracy metrics to assess the model's performance. The performance metrics were encouraging, with the precision reaching 73.24%, recall of 77.20% and F1-score at 65.19% for Class sample size = (no(t) x no(k))/(total number), where not is No_of test class no(). It can be noted that CKSAAP+ proved to yield. The support and the proportion of supporting votes for these classes ranged between 851 and 114, respectively, whereas the overall accuracy remained high, ranging from 88% to 92%. Further analysis provided an exciting view of the system using macro, micro and weighted averages. The macro averages were 75.25% for precision, 75.51% for recall, and balanced performance across all classes with an F-measure of the value equal to 74%. Considering the class distribution, the weighted averages resulted in slightly improved precision of 75.79%, recall - 75.39%, and F1-score - 0.48%. The micro averages, which measure the total true positives, false negatives and false positives across all classes, scored 75.4 % for precision-recall and F1 score, highlighting the model's performance stability.

articleTitle: Desktop Voice Assistant: Leveraging the Current State-of-the-Art in Speech Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Virtual voice assistants have transformed the way humans interact with computers, especially with mobile devices. This study examines the latest advancements in speech processing technologies to create a virtual voice assistant for desktop users. We examine the latest progress in speech recognition, natural language processing, and dialogue control. Important factors to consider are precision in quiet environments, compatibility with current desktop processes, and customization that suits user choices. We examine the possible advantages and obstacles of this approach, as well as identify areas for future research. This study proposes to connect mobile and desktop voice assistants using modern speech processing technologies, providin4g users with a smooth and effective method to control their computers through voice commands.

articleTitle: Fortifying Digital Frontiers: Enhancing Login Page Security Against Emerging Cyber Threats
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Security is crucial given the rising sophistication and ubiquity of cyber dangers in today's digitalised and networked world. The present study delves into the significance of safeguarding login pages as the primary precaution against cyberattacks. It specifically addresses the susceptibilities and possible impacts linked to compromised login credentials. The research explores various cyberattack techniques, particularly the dangerous consequences of dictionary and brute force attacks. The significance of strong security protocols, cooperative endeavours, and ongoing adjustment to dynamic threats is emphasised. Additionally, the document offers defence mechanisms and preventive measures such as rate limitation, password rules, IP whitelisting/blacklisting, adaptive authentication, two-factor authentication, account lockout policies and password hashing with salting. Additionally, a proactive approach that includes immediate user authentication, automated verification codes, and IP address restrictions is suggested to thwart hacking attempts and ensure a secure online environment. Login page security from cyberattacks is critical in today's digital environment. To reduce the dangers associated with hacked login credentials and maintain a safe online environment, it is imperative to implement a robust combination of security mechanisms, including two-factor authentication and proactive defence measures.

articleTitle: Climate Change Impact Analysis on Plantation
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Agriculture industry is highly dependent on the climate. Change in temperature and climate can growth crop yields in some places. This research explores the repercussions of climate changes on global crop yields by employing machine learning techniques. The dataset spans across various regions and encompasses 28,242 records featuring seven key columns. Focusing on essential crops, such as corn and soybeans, this study leverages geospatial data to analyses planting and harvest dynamics over the period 2001-2021. Utilizing advanced machine learning models, including deep neural networks and reinforcement learning, the research seeks to predict and quantify the impacts of climate changes on crop yields on a global scale. The selected variables, such as average rainfall, pesticide usage, and temperature, contribute to a comprehensive analysis of the complex relationships between climate variations and crop productivity. By adopting a data-driven approach, this research aims to provide valuable insights for sustainable agricultural practices and adaptation strategies on a worldwide scale.

articleTitle: Scalability and Performance Evaluation of Machine Learning Techniques in High-Volume Social Media Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In the modern era of digital communication, social media platforms are data factories and hence provide a new set of opportunities as well as challenges before the analysts. The objective of this paper is to evaluate the scalability and performance of various ML algorithms for social media data analysis in practice with high-volume datasets. The objective is to design ML algorithms that are scalable and achieve high accuracy when used with big datasets. In a literature survey, observed gaps in the present research advancements toward scalability and performance analysis for various ML techniques used for this intent. To make sure of diversity and size, we collected a big source from different social networks. The approach we did involve assessing a number of ML methods that are widely known like natural language processing (NLP), sentiment analysis (SA) and predictive analytics on scalability factors such as time to process and resource utilization while also considering performance metrics such as accuracy precision recall rate f1 score. The results demonstrate significant differences in the scalability of investigated approaches and their quality, such as some algorithms being more efficient or accurate at a large scale. This research adds value to the existing works in this area, by performing a detailed comparative study of ML techniques for large-scale social media data processing considering scalability vs performance tradeoffs. The findings are informative, for the research and practice community, on selection of suitable ML techniques that will be applicable to social media analytics; scalability is an important factor in this era dominated by big data. In future research, more advanced techniques and hybrids should be taken into account to enhance the scalability and performance of social media data analysis.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning System for Predicting Severity Under Single Transmission Line Outages
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The electric power system requires a deep comprehension of possible dangers and effective mitigation measures. Space-weather-caused single transmission line outages (STLO) threaten electricity grid reliability. The Line Voltage Stability Index (LVSI) is crucial for assessing power interruptions. Space weather events and their STLOs are unpredictable, making it difficult for power system operators to recognize and react to threats. This study develops a support vector machine (SVM)-based machine learning structure to overcome the following difficulties: This study discusses LVSI predictions of power system severity under STLO, considering various load situations for a complete ranking. The method can reliably forecast transmission line outage severity ratings via SVM with the Radial Basis Function (RBF) kernel. The study uses transmission line metrics, load features, and LVSI values under normal and outage conditions. Training and testing the SVM model on a large dataset proved its STLO severity classification accuracy.

Author Keywords: Line voltage stability index and Predictive modeling

articleTitle: A Survey on Blockchain for Rental Lease Management
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The application of blockchain technology is causing a revolution in the rental management industry by improving the security, privacy, traceability and visibility of any rental commodity. Complex tasks like commodity listings, lease agreements, payment methods, identity verification, and authentication are performed with unparalleled integrity, ultimately reducing the risk of fraud and disputes. The main objective of this survey is to review and analyse peer-reviewed literature that discusses previous works that present solutions to traditional rental lease management using blockchain technology. We start by elucidating the foundational concepts and traditional rental management industry.
