abstract: The objective of this project is to create a simulation for air cargo inspection using artificial intelligence (AI). This will be achieved by combining Pygame for simulating conveyor belts and YOLOv8 for detecting hazardous items. The simulation replicates a conveyor belt system that transports air cargo for inspection. Pygame, a robust game development package, is used to build a graphically interactive environment where users may view and examine the cargo inspection process in a simulated context. The primary element of the project entails using YOLOv8, an advanced object detection model, to precisely locate dangerous things within the shipment. The real-time detection capabilities of YOLOv8 allow for quick and efficient examination of the cargo, ensuring the timely identification of any hazards. The simulation serves as a platform to assess and verify the effectiveness of the AI-driven cargo inspection system across different scenarios. Users have the ability to engage with the simulation by modifying factors like the speed of the conveyor belt, the types of cargo, and the criteria for inspection. This allows them to assess the effectiveness of the system in identifying dangerous objects. This project functions as an instructional tool to comprehend the incorporation of AI in cargo inspection, while also having practical implications for improving real-world air cargo security. Pygame and YOLOv8, when combined, offer a flexible and robust framework for simulating and evaluating AI-based inspection systems. This contributes to the progress of air cargo safety and security measures.

articleTitle: Green Cloud Computing for the Metaverse: Powering the Future of the Internet with Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The emergence of the Metaverse is expected to significantly increase the energy demands on cloud computing infrastructure and data centres. Data centres heavily rely heavily on non-renewable energy sources like fossil fuels, resulting in high carbon emissions. This paper explores Green Cloud Computing (GCC) techniques to enable sustainable, energy-efficient cloud architecture for metaverse platforms. A multifaceted model is proposed, encompassing smart grid deployment, on-site renewable energy integration, energy storage solutions and real-time analytics. Specific strategies include advanced metering infrastructure, microgrids, solar panels, wind turbines, batteries, compressed air, and thermal storage. The model aims to minimise fossil fuel dependence and carbon emissions by transitioning to renewable energy sources. Smart grid optimisation can potentially maximise the utilisation of green power by 10-15%. On-site solar may provide 20-60% of data center energy needs, and wind turbines over 25%. Storage solutions, including batteries, compressed air and thermal, can meet 10-25% of demand fluctuations. Optimising workloads based on renewable availability can reduce non-renewable energy by 20-40%. The model has the potential to enable over 90% renewable energy usage for metaverse data centres, compared to the current 20% levels. The paper provides a framework and analysis of GCC techniques designed with the large-scale, energy-intensive infrastructure requirements of developing metaverse ecosystems in mind. The proposed strategies focus on applying advanced metering infrastructure, microgrids, various on-site generation solutions, and real-time analytics to create a dynamic, optimised and responsive energy supply tailored to the unique demands of metaverse workloads. Outlining a projected sustainability impact provides actionable insights into greening the foundational cloud architecture to power immersive virtual worlds.

articleTitle: Bayesian-Enhanced EEG Signal Analysis for Epileptic Seizure Recognition: A 1D-CNN LSTM Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The intricate neurological condition known as epilepsy, which is common across the world, presents consid-erable difficulties in accurately identifying and differentiating between non-epileptic and epileptic activity using electroen-cephalograms (EEGs). To customize successful therapies, it is essential to accurately identify the kinds of epileptic activity. Since epilepsy affects about 50 million people worldwide according to latest update of WHO and is typified by spontaneous seizures, early identification and prediction are vital in enabling people to minimize possible harm. The current seizure prediction methods lacks, with particular emphasis on their limited performance on small training datasets and their disregard for time-series data. To identify small patterns in EEG data, this study combines cutting edge technologies, like Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and 1D-CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) leveraging data from five hundred patients acquired from the UCI Machine Learning Repository. To optimize the 1D-CNN LSTM architec-ture and hyper-parameters, Bayesian optimization is employed, allowing for efficient exploration of the parameter space. It's effectiveness is not only limited to enhancing the performance metrics of a particular model but also minimizing the computing power required for fine tuning. The research evaluates the effectiveness of the 1D-CNN LSTM-based model, showcasing its potential as a reliable tool for automated epilepsy detection with accuracy of 99.47% (~<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">~</inf>100%), average sensitivity of 99.45%, and average specificity of 99.57%. This approach, emphasizes the significance of anticipating seizures in advance, attempts to provide epileptics the tools they need to control and avoid seizures in advance, so ultimately enhancing their quality of life for patients.

articleTitle: A Survey of Computational Techniques for Automated Video Creation and their Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: This study evaluated the inter-rater agreement among five evaluators on automatic video generation applications using Text-2 Video Computation models. The evaluation involved 15 criteria and used statistical analysis techniques to determine agreement. The results showed moderate agreement, with the highest-scoring applications being App A3 (Pictory), App A5 (DeebrainAI), and App A10 (elai). The study contributes to understanding inter-rater agreement in evaluating automatic video generation applications and highlights the highest-rated ones.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of Google Play and App Store Reviews of Threads
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: This research explores user sentiment of Meta's social networking app Threads, which is a part of another social networking application, Instagram, through sentiment analysis of its reviews on Google Play Store and App Store. The research uses a multi - pronged strategy that combines Kmeans clustering for spam identification, sentiment analysis, and keyword-specific sentiment analysis, using python as the programming language to find output. K-means clustering is first applied to remove spam from user reviews. The non-spam reviews are next subjected to sentiment analysis using RoBERTa – base, a natural language processing model,. Owing to its strong architecture, RoBERTa - base can process reviews with emojis and text in several languages with efficiency, guaranteeing accuracy sentiment analysis across a wide range of user-generated content. Furthermore, in order to identify the sentiment patterns related to a few important keywords, sentiment analysis is carried out independently on reviews that contain important keywords like “privacy” and “notifications.” A word cloud is created for all the non-spam reviews. Word clouds are also created for each category after the reviews are divided into groups according to the overall positive and negative sentiment scores in order to better investigate the opinions expressed. We will also generate a sentiment distribution of reviews over a timeline for better understanding of the target consumer's sentiments. Through the integration of sophisticated sentiment analysis techniques like RoBERTa - base, this study offers profound insights into users' perceptions and opinions of Threads, illuminating areas of user satisfaction and concern with the application.

articleTitle: Crunching Data for Early Warning: Predicting Renal Conditions in Real Time
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Chronic Renal Disease (CRD) poses a significant global health concern, impacting approximately one in five men and one in four women. Its insidious progression and late-stage diagnosis present a formidable challenge within the medical community. In response, our research has been dedicated to the development of a real-time CRD identification system, leveraging a dataset encompassing 798 individuals from a hospital. This dataset laid the groundwork for crafting an exceptionally accurate machine learning model. seamlessly integrated into a user-friendly web application using Streamlittechnology. Among the array of machine learning algorithms we explored, the LightGBM(light gradient-boosting machine)Algorithm distinguished itself by achieving an impressive 98.12% accuracy in predicting CRD. Beyond this accuracy, our investigation delved into the critical attributes that bear the most significance in CRD detection gives the top attributes from each algorithms with providing invaluable insights for healthcare professionals. Our interactive web application not only furnishes accurate predictions but also empowers healthcare providers and individuals to proactively assess CRD and institute early interventions. Our ultimate goal is to make substantial strides in addressing this challenging medical condition, thereby contributing to heightened survival rates and improved overall outcomes for individuals grappling with CRD on a global scale.

articleTitle: Community Detection Algorithms Tools and Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Now day Computer Science made a great effort to analyze large data and provided many network analysis algorithms. With the growth of Social Networks, the size of data on these networks increased rapidly. Finding the Community structures in these networks become a prominent area of research due to its applications in different areas. This paper presents a survey of different community detection algorithms proposed by different researchers and their applications in different fields. This paper highlighted the different areas where these community detection methods can be used like Health care, politics, recommendation system, e-commerce, economics, communication networks, and social networks. The motivation for writing this paper is to categorize all the published community detection algorithms and compare them to identify pros and cons of the algorithms. The paper is also showing progressing research work done by the different researchers in this field. At the end of the paper, the difference between community detection and clustering is discussed to clear these two data science concepts. This paper also presents different Social Network Analysis tools used by different researchers in their research.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Exploration of Stack Ensembling Techniques for Amazon Product Review Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: This review paper delves into the realm of sentiment analysis in e-commerce, specifically focusing on Amazon product reviews. Leveraging a stack ensemble machine learning model, we explore the intricacies of sentiment understanding and compare its performance against established models like Naive Bayes and LSTM-based approaches. The methodology involves meticulous data collection from Kaggle, preprocessing through text cleaning, tokenization, and lemmatization, and the construction of a stack ensemble model incorporating support vector machines, random forests and decision trees. Model performance has been evaluated using a variety of metrics, including confusion matrix, F1- score, recall, precision, and accuracy. Our comparative analysis reveals nuanced insights into the proposed model's strengths and weaknesses, showcasing its potential for advancing sentiment analysis in the ever-evolving landscape of e-commerce.

articleTitle: Decoding Excellence: TOPSIS and WASPAS Duel for Dominance in Ranking India's Premier Private Banks
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: This research paper employs multi-criteria decision analysis techniques, specifically TOPSIS and WASP AS, to evaluate and rank the top 5 Indian banks based on various financial and operational criteria. The study considers factors such as Price, Market capitalisation, TTM PE (Trailing Twelve Months Price Earnings ratio, Return on Equity, Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR), Interest Earned, and Net Interest Margin (NIM).

articleTitle: Multivariate Time Series Forecasting of Municipal Solid Waste
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Municipal solid waste is a major concern these days. With industrialization and urbanization, the amount of solid waste being generated has significantly increased over the years. This waste is mostly disposed to landfills and only a proportion of it is recycled. The waste on landfills has detrimental effects on health. Hence, it is important for the government to take appropriate measures by having enough recycling sites for regular treatment of solid waste. However, setting up of recycling units requires investment. Therefore, it is important to forecast waste that will be generated in coming years and at the same time predict the amount of waste that will be recycled. If the current recycling units are inadequate to handle the future quantities of waste generation, then probably more such units can be set up. Thus, this requires better forecasting of solid waste that will be generated and recycled. This study uses time series data to forecast waste generation and recycling. The study uses statistical models ARIMAX and machine learning models such as random forest, support vector regression, XGBoost for forecasting. The study also builds hybrid models by combining these models to find a model that provides higher accuracy, low error rate and thus better prediction.

articleTitle: Advanced Deep Learning Approaches: Utilizing VGG16, VGG19, and ResNet Architectures for Enhanced Grapevine Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: This study aims to give an overall comparison among three of the most powerful convolutional neural network (CNN) architectures-VGG16, VGG19, and ResNet for the classification of leaf diseases, particularly targeting leaf blight, ESCA, black rot, and healthy leaves. With the consequent economic effects of these diseases on viticulture, it is essential to create precise, productive, and scalable diagnostic tools for the pursuit of sustainable agricultural practices. Using a very large dataset of grapevine leaf images acquired from different localities, this study investigates the ability of the models to correctly assign the diseases to the visual symptoms. The models were assessed through a rigorous evaluation process including data preprocessing, augmentation, and stratified k-fold cross-validation approach to determine the overall accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score. The study results reflect no doubt that the ResNet model surpasses its rivals with an outstanding accuracy of 95% which is followed by VGG19 with 93.5% and VGG16 with 92%. These observations emphasize the power of deep residual learning and the importance of architecture depth in ensuring the accuracy of CNNs in the field of plant disease classification tasks. In addition, the study underlines the need for having holistic and varied datasets that train models to generalize across different environments and disease presentations. The current research adds to the growing knowledge base on the use of deep learning (DL) in agriculture, thus providing insight into the most efficient CNN networks that can be used for grapevine disease recognition. This work contributes to the integration of AI-based diagnostic tools in precision agriculture; this will eventually help improve the current disease management practices and foster sustainable crop production systems.

articleTitle: Decoding Financial Market: Opening Mysteries of the Indian Stock Market by Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Over recent years, the Indian Stock Market has witnessed a surge in popularity, evident from the substantial growth in DEMAT accounts, reaching 55 million by the end of FY-21. New traders, faced with the challenge of navigating the dynamic stock market, seek predictive tools for informed decision-making. This research paper addresses this need by employing two distinct methodologies: Random Forest Classifier (RFC) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) neural networks. RFC, a machine learning algorithm, is utilized to measure accuracy, F-score, precision, and recall, providing a comprehensive assessment of its predictive capabilities. On the other hand, LSTM, a deep learning approach, gauges its performance through the Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE). Through the application of these methodologies, the research aims to equip traders with effective tools for navigating the complexities of the stock market, fostering informed investment decisions in the face of market fluctuations.

articleTitle: Optimization of WDM-PON and TDM-PON Optical Networks for High Rate Information Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Nowadays people are running behind the technological devices which are based on high speed data transfer. Mobile, tablets and desktop computers are such examples of such devices. This paper focuses on technology which is used by these devices to transfer data and its optimization. WDM (Wavelength Division Multiplexing) and TDM (Time Division Multiplexing) are two basic technologies which are used when there are multiple users in traffic. In this paper two different types of Passive Optical Networks (PON) are designed based on WDM and TDM Technology and various relationship are obtained to judge the performance of a network. PON is chosen here to reduce the final cost of Passive optical network. Active Optical Network (AON) offers the high cost. WDM-PON and TDM-PON are two different passive optical networks which is to be designed for the range of bitrate between 10 Gbps to 50 Gbps. The main two parameters used to measure the system performance are BER and QF which measures the errors in transmitted bits and quality obtained by the received signal. OptSim 2023 software is used to design the said networks.

articleTitle: Garden Irrigation System Using IOT
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Addressing the global challenges of water resource depletion and efficient agricultural water management has led to the emergence of an innovative solution - the integration of Internet of Things (IoT) technology into irrigation systems. This abstract introduces a smart irrigation system designed to harness IoT capabilities, ultimately optimizing water utilization and enhancing crop yields. The proposed smart irrigation system comprises several key components: sensor nodes, actuators, a central controller, and cloud-based data analytics. Soil moisture sensors are placed in field, continuously monitoring soil moisture levels in real-time. These sensors transmit the collected data wirelessly to a central controller. This central controller, equipped with predefined thresholds and crop-specific parameters, processes the incoming data to determine irrigation requirements. To control water flow within the irrigation system, the system employs actuators like water pumps or valves. The central controller makes data-driven decisions, activating or deactivating these actuators based on sensor data analysis. Moreover, the system has the capability to incorporate weather forecast data to dynamically adjust irrigation schedules. Crucially, cloud-based data analytics play a pivotal role in this system. They store and analyze the collected data using advanced algorithms and machine learning techniques. This analysis identifies patterns, optimizes irrigation schedules, and generates actionable insights for farmers. The system also enables notifications and alerts, which can be sent to farmers through mobile applications or web interfaces, allowing them to remotely monitor and manage the irrigation process.

articleTitle: Facial Expression Analysis: Unveiling the Emotions Through Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Facial emotion detection systems have evolved alongside advancements in computer vision and machine learning technologies, enabling the recognition and categorization of human emotions through facial expressions. These systems find applications across healthcare, marketing, content creation, and security sectors. The historical progression reflects a shift from rule-based approaches to deep learning architectures like convolutional neural networks (CNNs), improving accuracy and robustness.However, challenges exist, including accuracy limitations, cultural diversity, biases in data and algorithms, and privacy concerns. Intrinsic and extrinsic factors such as aging, facial expressions, plastic surgery, low resolution, and noise impact system performance.Despite challenges, facial emotion detection offers advantages like refined customer insights, personalized marketing, and improved customer service. It aids psychological research and develops emotionally intelligent interfaces.Addressing challenges requires interdisciplinary collaboration, ethical considerations, and robust methodologies. Leveraging machine learning and deep learning, along with preprocessing and optimization, facilitates the development of facial emotion detection systems to enhance user experiences responsibly and ethically.

articleTitle: Patient Monitoring and Diagnozing using Telemonitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) has proven its importance almost in every field like healthcare, agriculture, transportation and smart cities. It enables the communications among various objects and human beings. In the healthcare sector IoT allows remote diagnostic of the patient by transmitting vital information of the patient in real-time. Thus, patients can get benefitted from the expert opinions of the doctors. An IoT based health monitoring model E-Dispensary has been developed. This system can transfer the essential physiological parameters of the patient to the doctor in real time. In the past, telemonitoring makes it possible to decrease the number of hospitalizations. Therefore, the proposed IoT based E-Dispensary will help a patient to communicate with doctor from the remote location. Through the video conferencing facility, the doctor can now interact with patient and if required doctor can deliver the drug to the patient through the infusion pump. Therefore, the remote patient monitoring will allow to reduce the unnecessary visits of a patient in the hospital and allows the doctors to access the patient data in real-time. This is an IoT based solution which will surely help the healthcare industry and relative of the patient to monitor the patient in real-time.

articleTitle: Fare Payment in Buses Through IOT Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In India, where agriculture is pivotal to livelihoods and the economy is one of the most populous countries in the world, India should have the best and fastest transportation system to manage the crowd while going to their workplace or for any other purpose. Most of the people who work in the industrial or IT sectors live almost near their workplace so that they can go by their own vehicle or bus. Most of the revenue from the transportation system is earned from bus transport. Human errors such as ticket fraud and passengers losing their tickets are common when the load of transportation is heavy and the buses become crowded. To reduce these frauds and mistakes, the introduction of a card system integrated with GPS technology to record the entry and exit of passengers is the best way to come up with. The development of a user-friendly payment gateway helps passengers check and renew the balance on their card. The implementation of these systems in the transportation system helps in easy and efficient monitoring of passengers. When the bus is the most used mode of transport, it should be advanced accordingly, along with the current technologies being updated in other sectors.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Energy Saving Electric Stove with an Automatic Heat Control System
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In Ethiopia, imported and locally manufactured electric stoves are used for cooking and baking food. An imported electric stove consumes less electric power, whereas locally manufactured electric stoves are the most energyconsuming appliances in the household. In both cases, electric power is dissipated in the form of heat through the resistor even though the power indicator is in the closed position in an imported electric stove because current flowing through the resistor is maintained. Due to this problem, an automatic heat control mechanism is designed in order to reduce unwanted excess heat loss. In addition to this, it solves different problems in society, such as reducing time, material consumption, resource waste, and human power. The required data for the project was gathered from the published papers, EEU, and from local communities through an oral interview about the cost and electric consumption of imported and locally manufactured electric stoves. The market's supply of temperature controllers, resistors, and contactors, as well as their attributes, were evaluated. One customer's annual savings in electric energy use was 1,805.983 KWh on average. An automatic heat management system allows society to conserve energy. The University of Gondar, Institute of Technology, created and manufactured the electric stove with an automated heat management system. This electric stove will be moved to the student café on the UoG Fasil campus.

articleTitle: RetinaCare: Diabetic Retinopathy Detection with VGG16-based Web Application
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: According to the International Diabetes Federation (IDF), According to the IDF, it is estimated that about one-third of people with diabetes have some form of diabetic retinopathy (DR). The prevalence of DR patients is projected to increase to 3.2 million by the year 2030. In high-income countries, there is an anticipated decrease in DR. Nevertheless, the focus persists on the vital significance of early identification and intervention in developing countries. The healthcare sector benefits significantly from early disease recognition. Advancements in artificial intelligence (AI) and deep learning (DL) in recent times have produced successful approaches in the detection and assessment of DR. Hence, the study introduces a web-based tool called RetinaCare, which integrates a CNN-based architecture for grading diabetic retinopathy (DR). To achieve multimodality, a CNN-based model is trained on top of VGG-16. The suggested framework exhibited an accuracy level of 96.89%, a specificity of 97.49%, and a sensitivity of 97.35%, showcasing its robust performance and high diagnostic capabilities. This innovative approach addresses the need for efficient and accessible solutions in resource-limited settings, contributing to advancing healthcare interventions for individuals at risk of diabetic retinopathy.

articleTitle: VNCESM: VGG-Net Based Conjunctive Eyes Segmentation Model with Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The future of healthcare is being altered by technology; non-invasive medical techniques assisted by technology are preferred for medical diagnostics. One of the common illnesses harming people's health worldwide is conjunctivitis, and using cutting-edge technology to treat this condition would greatly lower its prevalence. The goal of this work is to use deep learning to do conjunctiva region segmentation for non-invasive conjunctive eye detection applications. The suggested VGG-net Based Conjunctive Eye Segmentation Model (VNCESM) effectively segments conjunctiva from digital eye pictures taken in an uncontrolled environment by using fine-tuned CNN architecture. Pre-processing and image augmentation were done to boost the model's performance and data volume. UNBCSM demonstrated strong segmentation performance, with segmented masks for training and validation of 97.47%, and 95.49% respectively.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Blackbox in Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The aim of this research is to develop an accident detection system for cars by using alcohol detector, gyroscope, temperature sensor, humidity sensor, GPS and GSM. It can detect the occurrence of accidents and provide immediate assistance to the passengers. In these cases, urgent recovery or urgent help for reducing the number of death chances in accidents. So, keeping this problem in mind we have created a solution for this and created system which will help the victim to get immediate help from their SOS emergency contacts. SOS emergency contacts are the contacts that are provided so that urgent contact is done with that person. The system uses a blackbox along with multiple sensors including an alcohol detector, vibration sensor, temperature sensor, humidity sensor, GPS, and GSM.

articleTitle: Enhancing Glaucoma Diagnosis Through Image Processing and Supervised Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Glaucoma, a condition causing permanent blindness, is often symptomless, making early diagnosis challenging. The pipeline employing Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), provides an interpretable Glaucoma assessment, including confidence levels and structural segmentations. Integrated into a mobile app, the pipeline's efficiency was evaluated in terms of time and space complexities, showcasing its potential for widespread Glaucoma screening. The deep learning architecture, featuring six layers with dropout and data augmentation, demonstrated robust diagnostic performance n ORIGA and ACRIMA datasets.

articleTitle: Classification of Waste with the Assistance of YOLO
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Managing waste is a global concern that necessitates innovative approaches to optimize the collection process. The proposed system uses a network of cameras installed in waste collection trucks or stationary locations to capture images of waste disposal sites in real time. The YOLO algorithm instantly provides feedback on the types and quantities of waste that are visible after examining these images. Subsequently, collection routes are optimized, certain waste categories are prioritized like organic, inorganic, dry waste, and resources are allocated efficiently with the use of this data. Our design of the project prioritizes the ability to precisely identify the different categories of waste, which is crucial for waste collection.

articleTitle: Optimizing Data Transmission: Analyzing FSO Based DWDM System in Turbulent Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: There is a wide variety of network access technology available, including coaxial and copper cables, broadband radio frequency, wireless internet access, optical fibre, and many more. These technologies suffer from a number of drawbacks, including a crowded spectrum, a slower data rate, pricey license fees, and concerns over data security, and expensive installation expenses. Information may be sent via the free space optical channel using the services provided by Free Space Optics. FSO communications are gaining attention as a potential solution to the problem of a bottleneck in the last mile of a local area access network. These advantages stem from their wide data transmission capacity, cost-effectiveness in deployment, comparatively low energy use, resistance to interference, and superior degree of protection in comparison to other wireless technologies. The process of sending beams of light through the air is referred to achieve optical communication. In FSO, the optical source that is used at the transmitter is either a LED or LASER. This innovation aims at designing FSO based DWDM systems varying in number of channels and observing the effect of variation of channel length with the increase in number of channels. Moreover, different methods incorporate to mitigate the effect of turbulence.

articleTitle: Strengthening the Security of IoT Devices Through Federated Learning: A Comprehensive Study
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: There is a strong need for having an operative security framework which can help in making IoT (Internet of Things) devices more secure and reliable which can further protect from adversarial intrusions. Federated Learning, due to its decentralized architecture, has emerged as one of the ideal choices by the research practitioners in order to protect sensitive data from wide IoT-based attacks like DoS (Denial of Service) attack, Device Tampering, Sensor-Data manipulation etc. This paper discusses the significance of federated learning in addressing security concerns with IoT (Internet of Things) devices and how those issues can be minimized with the use of Federated Learning has been deliberated with the help of comparative analysis. In order to perform this comparative analysis, we investigated the published work in FL based IoT application for the last five years i.e., 2018–2022. We have defined a few inclusion/exclusion criteria and based on that we selected the desired paper and provided a comprehensive solution to IoT based applications using FL approach. Federated learning offers an optimistic approach to intensify security in IoT environments by enabling collaborative model training while preserving information privacy. In this paper a framework named Federated AI Technology Enabler (FATE) has been envisaged which is one of the recommended frameworks in safeguarding security and privacy measures of IoT devices.

articleTitle: Farmer Well-Being with Metaverse Innovations in Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The concept of the metaverse, a virtual interconnected space, has gained significant adhesion in recent years, promising transformative impacts on various industries such as smart agriculture, smart and green society and many more. The Internet of Things (IoT), and the Metaverse come together to generate a groundbreaking convergence that has the potential to change the agricultural industry. In a controlled environment of smart farming, a network of integrated devices with sensors, software, and internet connectivity enables automation, remote monitoring, and smarter decision-making. Sensors can track soil moisture, forecast weather conditions, and assess the health of crops, all of which can help to maximize agricultural profits. The metaverse can assist the farmers in receiving guidance from SME's (Subject Matter Expertise) in a virtual environment that offers several methods of digitally interacting and experiencing different use cases. This research paper delves into the potential future of the metaverse within the context of smart agriculture, exploring how technological advancements can shape the agricultural landscape. Apart from this, this study also explores that the present Metaverse trend focuses on the education gap that exists now, which may lead to a cooperative effort to bring about significant improvements in the agricultural industry. This study presents a roadmap for the evolution of smart agriculture in the metaverse, highlighting the role of collaboration between technology developers, agricultural experts, and policymakers. This research contributes to the understanding of how the metaverse can revolutionize traditional farming practices, paving the way for more efficient, sustainable, and technologically advanced agricultural systems.

articleTitle: Strategic Integration of Analytics and Artificial Intelligence in Sustainable Human Resource Management: Fostering HR Excellence
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The human resource management field is undergoing a transformation characterized by the convergence of advanced technologies, organizational strategy, and sustainable Human resource [HR] practices. The study lays the groundwork for successful HR analytics by emphasizing the significance of managing critical data, ethical considerations, and responsible AI governance, as this would foster a way to enhance and achieve HR excellence. It further looks at how advanced analytical methodologies and AI technology can improve the sustainability and effectiveness of HR management practices. Its objective is to explore the transformative capabilities of these technologies. The research aims to promote HR excellence by improving decision-making processes, increasing worker efficiency, and developing sustainable HR practices. This paperseeks to provide critical insights and theoretical foundations that contribute to developing sustainable HR practices and promote excellence in the overall HR management field. It proposes a conceptual, integrative model to help understand the above perspective.

articleTitle: Nostalgia Hub Using MERN Stack: User-Centric Design and Privacy Preservation
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Using the MERN stack, this research paper investigates the advent of a Nostalgia Hub with an emphasis on user-centric layout and privacy safety. The goal of the web application Nostalgia Hub is to make users feel nostalgic by deciding on and showcasing old fabric. They take a look at the technical details of making such a platform and stress how essential it is to give consumer experience and privacy top precedence while designing it.

articleTitle: A Quadra-Port Circular-Patch Antenna with DMS/DGS Designed on thin Substrate for WLAN And Satellite X-Band Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The research includes single, and Quadra-port <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{MIMO}._{5.50/7.50\text{GHz}}$</tex> antenna radiating EM wave designed for WLAN and Satellite X-Band applications. The thin substrate with height of 0.254mm is used where radiating-patch with defected-microstrip-feedline is printed on top-plane and defected ground on opposite plane for electromagnetic energy radiation. The single-port dimension is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$14\times 20\ \text{mm}^{2}$</tex> and four-port <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{MIMO}_{5.50/7.50\text{GHz}}$</tex> is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$28\times 40\ \text{mm}^{2}$</tex>. The single-port produces bandwidth of 5.00GHz-10.0GHz while its <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{MIMO}_{5.50/7.50\text{GHz}}$</tex> counterpart achieves bandwidth of 5.50GHz-11.61GHz. The <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{MIMO}_{5.50/7.50\text{GHz}}$</tex> configuration maintains isolation of more than 14.0dB with peak gain of 3.0dBi at single-port and 4.50dBi in four-port <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{MIMO}_{5.50 / 7.50 \text{GHz}}$</tex>. The proposed high-speed MIMI5.50/7.50GHz can be deployed in low frequency application infrastructure.

articleTitle: Gesture Recognition System for Human-Computer Interaction using Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In order to improve human-computer interaction (HCI), this paper presents the Gesture Recognition System (GRS), which makes use of computer vision techniques. With hand gestures recorded by a webcam, users can operate computer functions with this system. The goal of the paper is to use the Python MediaPipe library to create a gesture recognition algorithm that is both accurate and efficient. Hand tracking, landmark detection, and gesture classification are all part of the methodology. Real-time experiments are used to assess the system's performance, and optimization strategies are investigated to improve speed and accuracy. The outcomes show how well the suggested system works to facilitate natural and intuitive computer interaction, opening up possibilities for a wide range of applications.

articleTitle: Bi-Directional Gravity-Oriented Search Optimization Protocol for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In the current intellectual milieu, the central focus is directed towards the scientific domain of the IoT, fortified by the framework of wireless sensor networks. A WSN encompasses an assembly of sensor nodes engaged in intercommunication, aggregating environmental data, sending it to a server or base station to facilitate judicious decision-making. In light of their constrained battery longevity and untimely exhaustion, demanding subsequent redeployment, these sensor nodes pose intricate challenges. Recent scholarly pursuits have utilized a clustering approach in order to improve overarching lifespan of network. Utilizing cluster heads facilitates the communication of information from nodes to the central head waiter. Notably absent in current clustering techniques is the optimal methodology for forwarding data from sensors to the server and selecting the most suitable cluster heads. This paper introduces an innovative approach for WSN in the situation of IoT applications, employing Mobile Agents (MA) to assembledata from nodes. The methodology is grounded in the Two-Fold Gravitational Search Algorithm (GSA). In this process, the Mobile Agent's route for congregation facts from feeler nodes undergoes optimization using GSA subsequent to its efficient selection of cluster heads. The optimization criteria encompass variables like nodes' residual energy and the associated communication cost in relation to the base station (BS). In the evaluation of network longevity and energy efficiency, the proposed methodology has been juxtaposed against alternative clustering protocols. Furthermore, the success rate and energy consumption associated with task execution in the MA's itinerary planning, based on the GSA, have been scrutinized in comparison to alternative itinerary planning techniques. Comparative analysis reveals that, in contrast to alternative approaches, the suggested protocol exhibits enhanced association immovability, abridged the energy consumption, and a heightened success rate for MA.

articleTitle: Automated Detection of Wheat Powdery Mildew Using YOLACT Instance Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: There is a 5% annual decline in wheat results worldwide due to Blumeria graminis f. sp. tritici (Bgt), which makes an accurate identification methodology important. This study addressed the challenges encountered in early wheat powdery mildew detection through the development of an innovative technique that makes use of the YOLACT model, a real-time object recognition system. The review of the literature covers a variety of approaches, such as deep learning and hyperspectral imaging, with an emphasis on YOLACT incorporation for improved early detection. The study describes dataset collection, YOLACT integration, and preparation methods. Having a 95.6<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>recognition rate, a mean Intersection over Union (MIoU) of 0.85, a precision of 0.81, and a mean average precision (mAP) of 0.56, the results illustrate the efficiency of the YOLACT model. Comparative assessments illustrate how much stronger the suggested YOLACT methodology is. The study concludes by highlighting the accuracy of the YOLACT model in detecting wheat powdery mildew and stressing the value of texture analysis and the best possible combination of vegetative indices (VIs) for early diagnosis. By fusing technology with realistic farming situations, the YOLACT model not only increases disease identification but also can entirely reinvent agriculture and increase crop cultivation's sustainability and efficiency practices

articleTitle: You Only Look Once (YOLOv8) Based Intrusion Detection System for Physical Security and Surveillance
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In recent years, the need for advanced physical security and surveillance systems has been increased due to increase in trespassing, theft, vandalism etc. This paper presents an innovative and a novel approach to region-of-interest-based Intrusion Detection System for Physical Security and Surveillance by harnessing the advanced capabilities of You Only Look Once version-8 (YOLOv8), a state-of-the art object detection algorithm, trained and evaluated utilizing the Common Objects in Context (COCO) dataset. This dataset has a comprehensive compilation spanning of 80 diverse object categories which can be used with custom images to train and evaluate the model. Our methodology crafts an efficient and a robust Intrusion Detection System (IDS) for Physical Security and Surveillance employing the Python as a programming language and OpenCV library. Illustrious for its prompt and explicit real-time object recognition, YOLOv8 emerges as the most preferred framework for monitoring systems. Our model takes advantage of the rich information embedded in the COCO dataset to adroitly recognize and categorize intrusions across various scenarios. The study scrupulously delves into the essentials of implementation, encompassing data pre-processing, model training and strategic application of optimization techniques to intensify detection efficiency. The flexible and accessible nature of the Python programming language and OpenCV promotes the creation of a system flawlessly integrable with already existing security frameworks and hardware. Experimental findings emphasize the effectiveness of the proposed region-based Physical Intrusion Detection System in attaining high precision and recall rates for physical intrusion detection. This paper concludes with a subtle discussion, exploring practical implications, potential applications, and avenues for future research within the domain of computer vision-based intrusion detection systems. This research significantly chips in to the evolution of surveillance technology, bolstering security measures across diverse environments.

articleTitle: Improving Deep Learning Classifiers Performance using Preprocessing and Cycle Scheduling Approaches in a Plant Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The impact of plant diseases on the growth of their corresponding species enhances the critical importance of early identification. Farmers currently grapple with significant challenges posed by these diseases, jeopardizing entire seasonal yields. To address this pressing issue, this paper introduces a ResNet-based Convolutional Neural Network model designed to detect various early-stage plant diseases. The dataset employed comprises approximately 46,000 RGB images of both healthy and diseased crop leaves, categorized into six distinct classes sourced from Plant Village. The dataset is strategically divided into an 80/20 ratio for training and validation sets while maintaining the directory structure. Various preprocessing and data augmentation techniques are applied to the input image samples. Subsequently, a Resnet9 model is employed to extract features. The developed model exhibits an impressive accuracy of 99.37 % and a minimal loss of 0.0018. This proposed model demonstrates its capability to achieve promising accuracy in distinguishing between healthy and diseased plants, showcasing the effectiveness of the developed approach.

articleTitle: Digital Solutions for Crime Control: A Comprehensive Criminal Identification and Reporting Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: This paper presents the design and implementation of a comprehensive Criminal Identification and Reporting System (CIRS) aimed at enhancing law enforcement capabilities and improving public safety. The system enables users, including victims and law enforcement officers, to submit and manage complaints seamlessly through an intuitive online platform. Key features include the storage of user data in a secure database, real-time monitoring of criminal activity using CCTV footage, and advanced facial recognition technology for swift identification of potential offenders. The CIRS facilitates efficient case management by allowing users to track the status of their complaints and providing law enforcement agencies with valuable information to aid in criminal investigations. Moreover, the system assists local government agencies in maintaining records of known criminals, enabling proactive measures to prevent illegal activities. By leveraging cutting-edge technology and providing seamless integration with existing surveillance infrastructure, the CIRS promises to revolutionize criminal identification and reporting processes, ultimately contributing to improved public safety and law enforcement efficiency.

articleTitle: Bankruptcy Prediction Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Bankruptcy prediction is a critical task for companies, lenders, investors, and regulators. Accurately forecasting the likelihood of a company going bankrupt can help stakeholders make informed decisions, prevent financial losses, and mitigate risks. With its ability to handle vast amounts, machine learning has become a useful technique for bankruptcy prediction, identifying non-linear relationships, and learn from past patterns. In this, we present an bankruptcy prediction model using machine learning. We also focused on the key features used in the model, such as financial ratios, industry-specific metrics, and macroeconomic indicators. We also compared the different machine learning algorithms with better results. Finally, we highlight the importance of model evaluation and interpretability in bankruptcy prediction, and present some of the common metrics used to evaluate the model's performance.

articleTitle: Identifying and Categorizing Alzheimer's Disease with Lightweight Federated Learning Using Identically Distributed Images
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Among the leading causes of mortality in developed countries are neurological diseases like Alzheimer's disease (AD). Amazing results have come out of studies that have used algorithms powered by computers. Deep models are all the rage right now, especially in the world of image processing. Many academic studies have focused on deep learning for Alzheimer's disease detection since 2018. This paper introduces a simplified framework for federated deep learning to classify Alzheimer's diseases while ensuring the security of private information. This work uses IID (Independent and Identically Distributed) to test federated deep learning models using a distributed client-server architecture to safeguard client data. The framework was tested with one and numerous clients in traditional and federated learning situations. AlexNet's accuracy of 98.53 percent made it our standard after analyzing other pre-trained models. IID datasets were then evaluated using federal learning (FL). The framework's advanced features make it the optimal choice for early-stage diagnosis and classification of Alzheimer's disease.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Integrity Checker for Data Security
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Data Integrity refers to the state of the data we store in our database. The data should be unchanged aside from corrections and updates for Data Integrity to remain and be present in the system. The Data Integrity Checker (DIC) I wish to design and develop should play a part in maintaining the integrity that should be present in all database systems. As for the development, mostly MySQL and PHP will be utilised. Firstly, there needs to be a database to maintain integrity in, so a database containing a multitude of made-up records will be used. Then, there should be an interface which allows for ‘Admins’ and ‘Users’ to login and then interact with the database through SQL queries and such, and then there should be another table which has records of all queries made, which user or admin it was made from and at which time it was done. Data Integrity is essential to maintain in any sort of database as the main functions of most if not all organizations that utilize data hinder on the authenticity and accuracy of the data they use, so, in a sense, maintaining Data Integrity is one of the top priorities of any data-driven system.

articleTitle: A Super-wideband Flexible Four-Port MIMOsup Antenna for ON-Body Multi-Band Applications with Bandwidth Ratio 19.38:1
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: In this communication, a tapered-feed monopole antenna radiating EM energy with partial ground on a thin substrate is designed and analyzed for single as well as four-port MIMO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">sup</inf> antenna. The bandwidth is useful for wireless services including WLAN, X-band satellite communication, Ku-band, RADAR communication andmillimeter-Wavebands including n257, n258, n259, n260, n261, n262, n263. The MIMO antenna also offersgain of 6.75dBi at 60.0GHz with desired 2-D radiation pattern.

articleTitle: SSVBT: Secure Certificateless Aggregate Signature Scheme in VANETS with Block Chain Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The proliferation of Vehicular Ad-hoc Networks (VANETs) highlights the crucial need for secure, privacy-protecting inter-vehicle communication. By integrating blockchain technology with a safe certificate-less aggregate signature process, this research presents a novel approach to enhancing VANET security. Traditional VANET signature systems that rely on PKI and certificates have their limitations solved by the suggested approach. Using a certificate-less paradigm eliminates the requirement for a certificate authority when creating keys, making key exposure and compromise less probable. By combining several signatures into one smaller one, the aggregate signature method significantly decreases network communication cost. The paper introduces blockchain technology as an extra component to the certificate-less aggregate signature, further ensuring the honesty and openness of the VANET. The blockchain records and validates transactions, aggregate signatures, key alterations, and more using its distributed and immutable ledger. This not only improves the signature scheme but also creates a VANET environment that is trustworthy and robust.

articleTitle: Analysis of Big Data in Cloud Computing Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The abstract provides a brief summary of the research paper, highlighting the key topics covered. It explains that the paper will give a brief description of the various technologies and tools used for Big Data in cloud computing environments, as well as the advantages and difficulties posed by this technology. This paper reviews the research challenges and issues associated with big data analysis in situations using cloud computing. It discusses both the traits and benefits of big data analytics in cloud computing, and highlights the major research challenges such as scalability, security, privacy and resource management. The paper also presents some failure research directions and potential solutions to address these challenges.

articleTitle: Bio-Inspired Metaheuristic Feature Fusionmethod for Multi-Biometric Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Security for personal data has grown in importance in recent decades as a result of the internet's continued expansion. Various ways for recognising individuals are implemented to safeguard their personal information. The identification of users by their distinct physiological characteristics is a significant obstacle for biometric recognition systems. Therefore, in order to construct an effective multimodal recognition system, we used two modalities-the iris and the veins in a person's finger-to identify that individual. For feature extraction, the retrieved from imagesfinger vein and iris images are sent into the Adaptive Drone Squadron Optimization (ADSO) system. The characteristics obtained from the finger vein and iris are combined using a hybrid feature fusion method based on the suggested Enhanced sperm swarm optimization (ESSO) algorithm. Finally, Several-Phase Recurrent Neural Network(SP-RNN) is employed for personal recognition. Accuracy (0.97), True Negative Rate (TNR) (0.97), True Positive Rate (TPR) (0.96), Cumulative Match Curve (CMC) (0.907), Equal Error Rate (EER) (0.1001), Privacy (89.455), Rank-1 (88.0057), ROC (0.919), and security (88.820) were all improved by the suggested method.

articleTitle: Improved Detection of Fusarium Head Blight in Wheat Ears through YOLACT Instance Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The Fusarium fungus, specifically Fusarium Graminearum, is the primary cause of Fusarium Head Blight (FHB), poses a significant menace to wheat, barley, and maize cultivators. Beyond manifesting symptoms like head discoloration and bleaching, FHB cunningly generates mycotoxins, detrimentally impacting grain quality, market appeal, and sustainability. Despite farmers' commendable use of fungicides, eradicating Fusarium Head Blight (FHB) remains a formidable challenge. The goal of this project is to perform a variety of research and develop novel tactics to aid in the ongoing fight against FHB. The goal is to provide a technology-driven solution for accurate yield estimation and selective harvesting, with a focus on the latter growth phases. To achieve accurate wheat ear segmentation from the background, the YOLACT model integrates modern tools such as RGB imaging captured in diverse environments. Significantly, the utilization of deep learning, a key aspect of our approach, involves color image processing to enhance FHB detection accuracy in the field. Highlighting that our proposed approach achieved an impressive accuracy of 98.81%. The proposed approach aligns with a forward-thinking perspective valuing innovation to mitigate the detrimental effects of this ubiquitous fungus on agriculture and the economy.

articleTitle: A Literature Review on Clickbait Detection Techniques for Social Media
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The rising popularity of social media offers advantages like cost-effectiveness, user-friendliness, and rapid content consumption. However, this increase in popularity has led to a new issue known as clickbait. Clickbait refers to the deliberate spreading of misleading information to attract reader interest. This tactic draws users to click on and interact with content in various formats, including audio, video, text, and images. Consequently, users often find themselves watching a video that fails to deliver the promised information in its title or thumbnail. Clickbait thumbnails typically feature exaggerated or deceptive visuals to attract viewers into clicking. While these can significantly boost click-through rates and web traffic, they risk spreading false or low-quality content, diminishing online information sources' trust and credibility. As a result, researching methods to identify clickbait on social media is becoming more critical. In this study, the author conducts a literature review to evaluate the effectiveness and F1 score of different clickbait detection techniques.

articleTitle: Analysis of Area-Controlerror in Automatic Generation Control
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The Automatic Generation Control shares an objective to regulate the active power production according to the different power requirements, thus maintaining the expected energy flow and frequency in the network itself by connecting the desired control areas with power connection. A sudden change in energy can affect the magnetic currents in various motors and also cause instability in various electrical systems. In a modern and complex energy system, AGC plays an essential role and becomes an essential element in ensuring high quality energy supply to consumers, regardless of constant fluctuations in energy demand. When there are load fluctuations in the power grid, AGC plays a key role in maintaining optimal power exchange levels and grid frequencies while taking into account disturbance caused by load peaks. Therefore, to provide standard performance, the AGC system requires an intelligent efficient controller. The performance of different controllers depends on the choice of controller parameters used as well as the specific optimization algorithms. In literature research, the design and research of AGC has been further improved using advanced control strategies and intelligent metaheuristic strategies. Therefore, many researches have been conducted worldwide to provide many new control strategies to effectively solve the AGC problem. The centric goal of the proposed work is to study the concept of Automatic Generation Control while considering concept of area control with their respective simulations.

articleTitle: An Empirical Analysis of Invariance Hu's Moment Feature over a Digital Image
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: The invariant moment feature of Digital images provides a robust feature in the domain of computer vision to pattern classification and recognition for the last many years. Hu's seven invariant moments have a unique capability of image recognition under image transformation like translation, scaling, and rotation. Originally, Hu's moments were proposed under the assumption that the images are continuous domain and noiseless, but in the case of digital image moment, invariant features no longer remain perfectly invariant. This paper proposed a detailed analysis of these moments on digital images and observed that the invariance property is slightly degraded due to discretization in digitized images.

articleTitle: Cloud Based Predictive Maintenance System
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Maintenance is a critical aspect of modern industrial operations, as it ensures the reliability and longevity of equipment while minimising unplanned downtime. Traditional, schedule-based maintenance approaches are often inefficient and costly and fail to harness the full potential of data-driven insights. In response, cloud-based predictive maintenance systems have emerged as a transformative solution, leveraging the power of the cloud, data analytics, and machine learning to enable proactive maintenance strategies. This research paper explores the architecture, advantages, challenges, and potential applications of cloud-based predictive maintenance systems. We delve into the underlying technology, the role of the cloud in data storage and processing, and the use of machine learning algorithms for predictive analytics. We discuss how real-time monitoring and analysis of sensor data can help anticipate equipment failures, reduce operational costs, and increase overall efficiency.

Author Keywords: predictive maintenance system and data analytics

articleTitle: Identification of Spam Data in Cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: These days, most of the people using electronic mail for communication. Mostly all the industries, from business to education use email for communication. But there are many useless emails are received by spammers called as spam emails. Emails are the good opportunity for spammers since they able to use it for bad purposes like for their financial benefits, credit card information, market growth etc. The primary goal of spammer is to hack the sensitive and personal information of the user like contact details, bank account details etc. The spam emails are rapidly increased and fills with a lot of ridicules and useless mails which degrades our internet speed. Cloud computing is the user demand availability for data storage and security of user's personal information. In this paper, different machine learning techniques are used Naive bayes(multinomial and bernoulli), Support Vector Machine and decision tree to identify spam emails. First, taking a dataset and perform Exploratory Data Analysis and after that preprocess the data and pick features and build model and find the accuracy. In this paper, experiments have shown that the multinomial naive bayes technique return the good accuracy.

articleTitle: Chronic Disease Prediction Using Different ML Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: These days, emerging technologies like artificial intelligence (AI)is crucial to the developments in the medical field. Machine learning will become very helpful for experts in making their decisions fast, accurate and early disease predictions. Early disease prediction is very much needed for an easy cure and reducing the mortality rate for that specific disease. Machine Learning has various techniques for the prediction of different diseases, like some chronic diseases such as cardiovascular disease, Diabetes, Dementia, Cancer and Kidney failure. In this research study five different machine learning techniques, i.e. Decision Tree (DT), Logistic Regression (LR), Random Forest (RF), Gradient Boosting Model(GB) and eXtreme Gradient Boost (XGB) are analyzed for the mentioned diseases. For this analysis some parameters like Precision, Recall, f-Score, accuracy and Time complexity are considered. In the experimental setup the overall dataset is divided into two parts which is 70:30 as training and testing dataset. So the results obtained from the given experimental model show that the GB classifier will gives the most optimized results for heart disease prediction, LR gives a good result for diabetes prediction and XGBoost is best for dementia prediction while the time complexity is optimized for LR and DT.

articleTitle: Efficient Solar-Powered Induction Motor Drive for Water Pumping
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: This study aims to develop, supervise, and implement a solar photovoltaic (PV) array-integrated, speed sensor less direct torque control (DTC) system for an induction motor drive (IMD) applied in water pumps. The proposed approach utilizes a recommended flux observer for determining the stator flux, serving as a basis for determining speed. A dedicated dc-link current detector and a modified engaged voltage vector are employed for motor phase current reconstruction. In this setup, a single sensor is employed for both dc-link voltage sensing and dc-link current detection. All other essential parameters are then derived from these two observed signals. The IMD is powered by a PV array operating at its maximum power point (MPP). To regulate the MPP, the perturb and observe (P&O) control algorithm is recommended, complemented by an additional flow rate controller. This dual-control strategy enables dynamic adjustments to the flow rate while consistently monitoring the MPP throughout its operationalrange. The system's performance is evaluated through simulations conducted using MATLAB/Simulink and experimental tests conducted on a laboratory-developed prototype.

articleTitle: Test Suite Minimization Through PSO
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Regression testing is a critical stage that ensures the software changes are not affecting existing functionality. Ideally, conducting regression tests after each software change is essential. However, the exhaustive repetition of full tests for every alteration proves time-consuming, expensive, and demands significant resources. Test suite minimization serves as a solution by eliminating redundant test cases. This research presents an advanced approach to eliminate redundant test cases effectively. The proposed method focuses on identifying a concise yet effective set of test cases that align with requirements and efficiently uncover faults. This streamlined approach not only reduces testing expenses but also contributes to a more efficient testing process. The study demonstrates its effectiveness in minimizing the test suite by employing the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm with varied inertia weight strategies. Results from simulations indicate the success of this approach in reducing the test suite size while maintaining or even improving code coverage. Comparative analysis against Genetic Algorithms (GA) and Artificial Bee Colony (ABC) methods underscores the superior performance of PSO, specifically with tailored inertia weight strategies. This research significantly contributes to optimizing software testing methodologies, ultimately enhancing fault detection efficiency in software development.

articleTitle: Motion Sensor Alarm with TI LaunchPad and ESP8266 NuttyFi Implementation
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Recent times have overseen exceedingly high crime rates, and the appalling situation demands additional personal security measures. In light of the new advancements in technology, the demand for wireless systems has witnessed tremendous affinity, with major domains rapidly attempting to adopt the technique into their custom applications. Security is one such domain where wireless technology has thescope to achieve numerous practical applications. In one such instance, this study deploys the WiFi protocol over an intruder detection system using a TI LaunchPadMSP430. The TI launchpad is connected to the NuttyFi board which provides it with the internet connectivity required to put it online. The motion sensor acts as the input device that triggers the alarm which triggers output devices for intruder warning, in this case, a buzzerin parallel. The system also updates the alert in real-time online over the Blynk web server. This article combines embedded programming, wireless communication, hardware components, and sensing to build an intruder alert system. Using a page from technological baskets like IoT, RF, andembedded systems, the system fulfils a crucial requirement of the current society. Cross-platform usage boosts the utility of this system, putting it in the hands of millions of users.

articleTitle: AI Based Energy Efficient Clustering in Homogeneous WSN
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Wireless sensor networks (WSNs) have motivated researchers to explore novel approaches to optimize cluster formation. Clustering algorithms play a vital role in WSN s, wheresensor nodes are organized into clusters to reduce energy consumption and prolong network lifetime. This paper proposes an Al based energy-efficient clustering algorithm tailored for homogeneous clustering scenarios. The current research work leverages artificial intelligence techniques, such as ML. Optimization algorithms are used to dynamically form clusters based on the sensor nodes' energy levels and proximity. The key focus is on creating clusters with balanced energy distribution, which helps in avoiding the early depletion of energy in certain nodes and achieving a more uniform utilization of resources. The meaning of grouping calculations in WSNs couldn't possibly be more significant. These calculations should work out some kind of harmony between different clashing goals. On one hand, they should disseminate the bunch and make a beeline for guarantee even energy utilization among sensor hubs. On different, they should limit the above related with group development and support, as exorbitant bunching can prompt superfluous control message trades, accordingly, consuming extra energy.

articleTitle: AR and Online Purchase Intention Towards Eye Glasses
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
abstract: Augmented reality (AR) can be a potent tool for Indian online eyewear marketers by bridging the gap between online and offline purchasing experiences and meeting the needs of social validation and sensory engagement, which are preferences of Indian consumers. The present research explores how augmented reality (AR) technology affects Indian consumers' intentions to buy glasses online. A combination of descriptive and exploratory research design was used on the sample size of 236 consumers. Data was analyzed using frequency table and Structured Equation modelling (SEM) to identify the relationship amongst the variables. The findings indicate that accessibility to product information, telepresence, and perceived ease of use are important variables impacting purchase intention. AR can bridge the gap between online and offline experiences, meet consumer preferences, and create trust and confidence. Future research should explore AR's effectiveness and personalization possibilities for Indian online eyewear retailers. Future research should explore AR's effectiveness and personalization possibilities for Indian online eyewear retailers.

articleTitle: Exploring Deep Learning for Efficient Data Management in Brain Tumor Classification: An Overview
publicationTitle: 2024 11th International Conference on Reliability, Infocom Technologies and Optimization (Trends and Future Directions) (ICRITO)
